name: origins-of-life-vent
title: The Hydrothermal Vent Hypothesis
lead: The origin of cells, treated not as a single spark but as a staged sequence of nonequilibrium transitions at an alkaline hydrothermal vent, each one a falsifiable step a simulation can pass or fail. The guiding hypothesis is the alkaline-vent theory for the origin of life: the vent-ocean interface hands a nascent cell its first free energy (a natural proton gradient across thin mineral walls), its first reduced carbon (H2-driven CO2 reduction), and a place to concentrate and enclose that chemistry, before the cell evolves its own membranes, pumps and genes. The campaign builds that vent from real geochemistry upward (serpentinization, reactive transport, H2-driven carbon fixation, candidate self-amplifying networks — tested, not assumed) and runs the classical favorable scenario and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment head to head rather than assuming either. Every stage is a coupled Vivarium composite of genuine simulators (PHREEQC, FiPy, eQuilibrator, libRoadRunner, with a FEniCS/dolfinx FEM solver under pixi as a high-fidelity cross-check) under explicit conservation contracts. Thirteen consolidated studies — each gathering the campaign's run arms (36 in all) at several fidelities — build and run on real simulators. A five-act arc — the geological engine, chemical organization, chemical individuality, reproduction and evolution, and robustness and autonomy, plus the nitrogen/phosphorus/energy/growth bottlenecks — is judged act by act against matched nulls, with an adversarial vent-ablated control rejected by every discriminating gate. The honest headline is that the arc advances on persistence while endogenous autocatalysis is tested and refuted, and the central transition — chemistry maintaining a boundary that in turn sustains that chemistry — stays open. The sharpest results come from re-grounding each act on higher-fidelity model classes, which returns three honest negatives: carbon fixation's limiting step is structure-sensitive, no autocatalysis emerges at vent conditions without a one-carbon feed, and og-independence's {pump, importer, heredity} set is advantageous but driver-specific — not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact; the importer is required by no driver; the gradient is the hard dependency).

at_a_glance.role: The calibrated vent environment a cell would form in — the serpentinizing reactor settles in the Lost City window over ~80% of the grid, and conditioning (12.5% of plausible states bind, H2-limited) leaves a posterior 100% viable downstream, transport-class-independent (ledger 0/96); supported — a bounded, calibrated feed (no origin claim). The evolving mineral interface that delivers it over time is the separate og-vent-interface.

The cell's first carbon — H2-driven CO2 reduction reproduces the Preiner yield hierarchy and sustains net organic-carbon flux in a bounded pH/H2 region, controls collapsing (supported); the explicit electrochemical mechanism-attribution arm is refuted on a secondary question (the two model classes agree on which limitation dominates only 47%, below the 80% gate) — kept honest as an arm without flipping the supported headline.

Network persistence — the carbon-fixing network sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (supported); persistence is driven, not autocatalytic: under rule-generated real thermodynamics no self-amplifying motif emerges at the vent feed (formose only with exogenous formaldehyde, p=0.04 vs matched nulls), and the curated rTCA motif is reclassed as imposed + element-unbalanced. A provenance-gated reaction atlas supplies the balanced reactions both arms draw on. Endogenous autocatalysis (A2) is the separate og-autocatalysis line.

Multisolute spatial enrichment — long tight pores cross the concentration/retention threshold (Baaske cleared, accumulation Peclet 18.4) while open pores wash the feed through, but the eight-solute set fractionates (Soret-driven, co-localization index ~0.18) rather than co-localizing; supported transport physics within a bounded window. Whether that enrichment ignites the reaction network is the separate og-network-rescue.

Self-compartmentation — from a self-made amphiphile boundary (retention without isolation) to the first self-maintaining protocell whose membrane pays on persistence, with real fatty-acid vesicle MD replacing the phospholipid stand-in; studied at several fidelities as arms

Proto-energetics — capturing geochemical free energy into a transferable store, internalizing it under selection, and coupling a carrier; which coupling chemistry pays, studied at several fidelities as arms (the carrier buys dip-persistence, not more total throughput)

Chemical inheritance — a heritable chemical difference transmitted at feasible cost, need not presume RNA: competing inheritance modules graded head-to-head (compositional/hybrid escape the Eigen length catastrophe) and an information-per-cost frontier of six mechanisms; supported. Whether that inherited difference is selectable is the separate og-evolvability.

Protocell ecology — a cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding) and community function precedes cell completeness; studied as arms (og-36 stochastic community-vs-single, og-07 metacommunity, og-07-alt real metabolite exchange)

Escape and progressive independence from the vent — the minimum innovation set off-gradient, then a graded, attributed map of which innovation internalizes which support; a 2³ epistasis analysis shows the {pump, importer, heredity} set is advantageous but driver-specific, not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact; the importer is required by no driver; the gradient is the hard dependency)
Adversarial control: the gates must reject generic non-vent chemistry
Nutrient bottlenecks — reduced nitrogen keeps pace with carbon and reactive phosphorus co-concentrates in the pore (or limits first), studied as nitrogen + phosphorus arms

Reproduction — metabolism-coupled growth to a measured-geometry division with viable daughters, building a multi-generation lineage; studied at several fidelities as arms (og-33 coupled growth+division, og-growth-division fate, og-growth-alt physical reproduction)

Evolvability & selection — a daughter-inherited chemical difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference (parent-offspring correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control) and the population shifts under selection rather than drifting; qualified. The Gate-D selectable-fitness result, split from og-heredity (which carries the inheritance half).

Reaction-network rescue — at equal vent feed a concentrating pore ignites the full carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dark; supported (Gate B). Split from og-spatial-concentration (the enrichment half); also resolves network persistence (A1) feed-plausibility.

The evolving mineral interface — the coupled geochemical interface delivers reduced-carbon chemistry only within a bounded two-regime DIC window (under full redox equilibrium DIC draws down before free H2 appears); qualified on the realized DIC-cliff, with its sustained-flux / mineral-evolution / coupled-ledger findings still planned. Split from og-vent-environment (the calibrated-states half).

Functional precursor pool — the vent's reduced-carbon chemistry delivers a de-novo, atom-balanced, budget-closed precursor pool (carbon-source attribution, closed carbon/electron budgets) whose no-H2 / no-catalyst / no-gradient controls all collapse it; but within the defensible DIC window the functional C2-C3 precursors are thermodynamically bounded to sub-micromolar, orders below what the network and amphiphile studies can consume. Qualified. The concentration gap it exposes is taken up by og-operating-window.

Operating window — the real pore (FiPy Soret trap) plus membrane retention can lift the precursor pool from nanomolar to a consumable micromolar, but only in a narrow corner at the upper edge of defensible small-molecule thermophoresis (Soret coefficient near the ~1e-2/K ceiling with a high thermal gradient and high DIC; overlap volume ~0.11 of the defensible grid); the canonical mid-point does not clear it. Qualified, and hinging on the Soret coefficient of the C2-C3 precursors — measuring it at the vent gradient is the discriminating experiment. Consumes og-precursor-pool's yield vectors.

Self-maintaining individuality — the campaign's central reciprocal-maintenance target: the coupled chemistry-and-boundary loop does not maintain itself endogenously under defensible conditions. The amphiphile pool the chemistry produces falls ~4 orders below its critical aggregation concentration even at the operating window's favorable corner (~7 orders at the canonical point), so no membrane forms without assuming one and reciprocal maintenance never closes without a built-in retention gain. Refuted, scoped to endogenous closure; the broader individuality-emergence question stays open.

Evolvable lineages — given a granted individual, stochastic partition and variation produce real heritable, selectable adaptation that shifts the population above both matched nulls (no-inheritance and shared-feed) and re-tracks a changed environment, but it is bounded fixed-trait selection, not open-ended novelty (heritable variance declines as the population converges; the trait is a fixed scalar). Qualified. With the self-maintenance result it locates the binding bottleneck of the chemistry-to-life transition at individuality, not evolvability.

question: Could the first cells have originated at alkaline hydrothermal vents — and where does the geology-to-cells path run continuously, where does it depend on narrow regimes, and where does it break? Can a physically plausible early-Earth vent–ocean interface generate and sustain, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, persistent network chemistry, concentration, and compartments a protocell needs — without inserting metabolism, membranes, autocatalysis, or heredity by assumption?
hypothesis: Under field- and lab-consistent parameter ranges, a serpentinization-fed, spatially resolved alkaline vent reproduces the conditions for a cellular origin: it crosses, in order, falsifiable thresholds for sustained carbon fixation, network persistence, concentration/individuality, compartmentation, internalized energy, and heritable organization — with identifiable parameter regions where each step fails.

executive.what_is_this: A staged, falsifiable Vivarium campaign mapping where the geology-to-cells path at a serpentinizing alkaline hydrothermal vent runs continuously, where it depends on narrow regimes, and where it breaks. A cellular origin is treated as five acts of coupled nonequilibrium transitions — geological engine, chemical organization, chemical individuality, reproduction and evolution, robustness and autonomy — each judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal, with explicit competing scenarios. Not a demonstration that cells did originate at vents: a quantitative map of the bottlenecks between geology and cells.
executive.campaign_synthesis: Campaign synthesis — the geology-to-cells arc in one place (see campaign-synthesis.md), read as five acts, each judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal. Geochemical disequilibria can sustain carbon-reducing chemistry (Acts I–II), and a connected reaction network persists without endogenous autocatalysis — amplification beyond a degree-preserving null is refuted under vent conditions for both representable routes (A2, off-spine), on thermodynamics and on a seed-independence discriminator. Persistence is bought by spatial organization, retention and energy-buffering, not by productivity: a concentrating mineral pore rescues the network (Act II), but the chemically-necessary multicomponent set fractionates rather than co-localizing, and the rescue sits in a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity window. An endogenous membrane pays for itself on persistence (Act III), yet self-produced boundary closure and the chemistry-to-boundary feedback stay open; physical division is a measured propensity, not demonstrated self-maintaining fission; and open-ended chemical evolvability is unresolved (Act IV). Under reduced geological support the buffering, community and internalization mechanisms map a robustness/productivity frontier, not a demonstrated escape (Act V). The central scientific target the campaign now names is the emergence of reciprocal coupling: chemistry maintaining a boundary that, in turn, sustains and propagates that chemistry. Endogenous autocatalysis is not demonstrated and the chemistry-to-self-maintaining- individual transition is open — these are the campaign's sharpest results, kept first-class, not gaps papered over.
executive.act_i_status: Act I (geological engine) is qualified. The serpentinizing alkaline vent holds its Lost City window (T 40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with the charge/element ledger exact (|charge| = 0). Conditioning on that window leaves a posterior that is 12.5% of the prior yet in which 100% of the empirically supported vent states supply what downstream carbon fixation needs - transport-class-independent, ledger exact (0 of 96 points rejected). The dissolved-H2 window is the binding observation (pH is mineral-buffered near 9.4), so Act I delivers a bounded, calibrated feed of H2 / inorganic carbon / pH-redox gradient with a documented lifetime - a viable geochemical reactor within bounds, not an origin claim. It throttles on a bounded two-regime DIC window, and the H2 posterior depends on the DIC prior and the equilibrium-vs-kinetic carbon-redox choice (an open expert prior). Exit condition met: the calibrated, uncertainty-bearing feed with closed budgets and a documented lifetime that Act II consumes.
executive.act_ii_status: Act II (chemical organization) resolves to persistence, not amplification. Abiotic carbon production is supported: H2-driven CO2 reduction over the vent's Fe/Ni/S interface reproduces the Preiner/Hudson yield hierarchy (formate ~200 mM >> acetate ~100 uM >> pyruvate ~10 uM) and sustains net organic-carbon flux in a bounded pH-gradient x dissolved-H2 region, with every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst) collapsing formate below 1 mM; carbon fixation spends the proton gradient (~2 H+/carbon). Network persistence (A1) is met, qualified: a connected, carbon-fixing network sustains net throughput on the calibrated feed under washout. Spatial organization (B) is met: at the same vent-posterior base feed held equal, a concentrating mineral pore at a modest, physical porosity (0.88, pore-local ~0.023 M, enrichment ~23x) ignites the network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dead - spatial concentration is the only difference, confirmed directly on the six-carbon network (flux +4.49e-4, connected, 22 species) that ignites only at ~20x well-mixed feed. The rescue holds within a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity window (~0.80-0.90); the chemically-necessary eight-solute mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing (Soret-driven, co-localization index ~0.18 in the strong-Soret regime), a candidate spatial incompatibility. Endogenous autocatalysis (A2, off-spine) is refuted under vent conditions for both representable routes: the formose doubling step is thermodynamically condensation-favored (-16.4 kJ/mol) so its splitting direction carries no net flux, and on a coefficient-free discriminator production is seed-independent (feed-driven, not self-amplified); a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out because its reductive carboxylations run uphill under vent H2 (+18, +31 kJ/mol) - the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2 - though a labelled counterfactual shows the rTCA topology is autocatalysis-capable under a stronger reductant (a beyond-vent follow-up). Exit condition met: persistence is distinguished from endogenous amplification, and the pore rescue and the mixed-solute fractionation are both reported.
executive.act_iii_status: Act III (chemical individuality) is qualified and partly open. Self-compartmentation (C) runs on the Act-II pore-concentrated, carbon-fixing (not autocatalytic) network: an endogenous membrane raises the standing metabolite pool to ~2.9x a no-membrane ablation under the reduced-coupling model and ~1.98x under the MD-informed first self-maintaining protocell, while net fixation flux stays ~0.6-0.79x (throughput feed-limited) - it pays for itself on persistence, not throughput. Short Martini CG-MD gives a thicker long-chain bilayer (di-C16 2.870 nm vs di-C12 2.325 nm) -> lower permeability (0.256) -> higher retention (0.661), so composition sets permeability sets retention (a resolved coupling, not a free knob), and the system is self-maintaining on the measurable criterion (net amphiphile production >= degradation, beating the ablation at equal feeds) within a windowed integrity (membrane access >~0.45; k_deg <= ~0.01/s). Nutrient availability: reduced nitrogen keeps pace with carbon and reactive phosphorus co-concentrates in the pore (or limits first) - studied as nitrogen + phosphorus arms toward a joint C/N/P feasibility, not separate single-nutrient successes. Qualified and open because self-produced boundary closure and the chemistry-to-boundary reciprocal feedback are not yet closed (MD-informed, not PMF-resolved; the GPU gold-standard PMF is tracked, not hidden). The exit condition - closure of precursor-to-amphiphile synthesis plus an experimentally grounded permeability-retention feedback - is partially met: the permeability-retention feedback is MD- grounded; the synthesis closure is open.
executive.act_iv_status: Act IV (reproduction and evolution) is qualified. Reproduction: the protocell grows from its own amphiphile production and divides at a measured area-doubling geometry, building a multi-generation lineage (og-reproduction) - a measured division propensity, not emergent physical fission. Heredity: a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference (parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control under selection, og-heredity, seed-robust 5/5 graded seeds), with competing inheritance modules graded head-to-head - compositional and hybrid heredity escape the Eigen length catastrophe, so heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity RNA template. Both judged against matched nulls at equal feeds. Open: open-ended chemical evolvability (novelty beyond the seeded trait space) is not demonstrated, and physical division remains a propensity rather than self-maintaining fission - the planned membrane-MD division study (mem-m4) is a required mechanical validation, scaffolded, not run. Exit condition partially met: physical division propensity, transmission and multigeneration selection are shown; chemical novelty is open.
executive.act_v_status: Act V (robustness and autonomy) maps a frontier rather than a demonstrated escape, all qualified. An energy carrier buys dip-persistence, not more total work (og-energetics: dip useful work 0.030 vs gradient-only 0.006 kJ/mol, total work NOT improved 0.256 vs 0.282). A cross-feeding community out-produces the best single lineage (~1.9x, cross-feeding-causal) but pays in robustness with lineage loss at low counts - productivity-yes / robustness-no, the counterpoint (og-ecology). Progressive independence is a graded, attributed affordability map (og-independence): the required innovation set is driver-specific, not a universal triple - {pump, heredity} rescues the vent-pmf gradient (a hard dependency: the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral access and feed are freely/borderline survivable and the importer is never individually required. The adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate (min margin 1.8 decades) while the vent passes all five — consistent with vent-specific rather than generic gates, but a bounded claim: the all-negative generic control removes H2, catalyst and pore at once, so it is not clean evidence of vent specificity; the proper 3-way factorial and positive alternative-environment models are pending (og-vent-specificity, future work). Exit condition met as a robustness/productivity frontier and a graded support-withdrawal analysis - explicitly not an assumed vent escape, and the Hadean-ocean H2/organic floor that would turn the off-gradient map into a prediction remains an open expert prior.
executive.verdict: The full geochemistry-to-heredity arc runs end to end on real simulators, with conservation held to machine precision, and the campaign adjudicates its scenarios rather than asserting them. The sharpest results come from re-running each stage on higher-fidelity model classes under a feasibility / robustness / discrimination standard, and the honest headline is a spine that advances on persistence while endogenous autocatalysis was tested and refuted along the way. On the spine, a rule-generated C/H/O reaction network emerges and fixes carbon and then persists at vent-realistic feeds once a concentrating mineral pore is added - network persistence (A1) is met, qualified: a connected carbon-fixing network ignites inside a physical pore (porosity ~0.88, pore-local ~0.023 M) where a matched well-mixed control stays dead, within a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity window (~0.80-0.90), confirmed directly on the six-carbon network (spatial organization, B, met). Endogenous autocatalysis, by contrast, is refuted under vent conditions for both representable routes - A2, an off-spine branch, each with a mechanism: the formose doubling step is thermodynamically condensation-favored (-16.4 kJ/mol) so its splitting direction carries no net flux, and on a coefficient-free discriminator production is seed-independent (feed-driven, not self-amplified); a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out under vent H2 because its reductive carboxylations run uphill (+18, +31 kJ/mol), the same reason real rTCA uses ferredoxin, not H2 - though a labelled counterfactual shows the rTCA topology is autocatalysis-capable under a stronger reductant, noted as a possible beyond-vent follow-up. An endogenous membrane then pays for itself on persistence (standing pool ~2.9x reduced-coupling, ~1.98x MD-informed, over a matched no-membrane ablation) but not throughput, within a membrane-access window - Act III self-compartmentation (C) qualified (og-self-compartmentation reduced-coupling plus og-self-compartmentation's MD-informed first self-maintaining protocell, where composition sets permeability sets retention; PMF-resolved gold standard tracked as og-32a). Reproduction and heredity follow as a genuine positive - Act IV (D) qualified: the protocell grows from its own amphiphile production and divides at a measured area-doubling geometry (og-reproduction), and a daughter-inherited compositional difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference (parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, og-heredity), both against matched nulls at equal feeds. The optional Act V extension has run, all three qualified: an energy carrier buys dip-persistence not more total work (og-energetics), a cross-feeding community buys productivity ~1.9x but pays in robustness (og-ecology, the counterpoint), and a 2³ epistasis analysis maps a driver-specific affordability: the {pump, importer, heredity} set is advantageous but not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is required by no driver, and the gradient is the hard dependency) - an affordability map, not a demonstrated escape (og-independence). The earlier, lower-fidelity arc stands as the scaffold these sharpened: a Lost City vent (og-vent-environment) holding its window over ~80% of the swept grid with exact charge balance; H2-driven carbon fixation benchmarked against Preiner and Hudson (og-carbon-fixation); thermophoretic individuality, amphiphile compartments, internalized bioenergetics bounded by the Sojo cost, heredity that need not presume RNA, metacommunity robustness, and the {pump, importer, heredity} escape set (og-network-persistence through og-independence), plus the nitrogen, phosphorus, energy-currency and growth/division modules. An adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate — consistent with vent-specific rather than generic gates, though bounded: the all-negative control removes H2, catalyst and pore at once, so it is not clean specificity evidence, and the proper 3-way factorial is pending. Three honest negatives are the sharpest of these: carbon fixation runs but which limitation stops it is structure-sensitive (the Butler-Volmer and empirical classes agree on the label only 47% of the time against an 80% gate, so the mechanism map, not a pass, is the result; charge/electron ledger exact on 750 runs); the eight-solute mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing in one thermophoretic pore (concentrating one tracer is not concentrating the set a protocell needs together); and og-independence's {pump, importer, heredity}, re-asked inside one persistent world across 24 model structures, is advantageous but driver-specific — not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact positively; the importer is required by no driver; the gradient, not the triple, is the hard dependency). The vent calibration anchors the arc: conditioning on the Lost City windows leaves a posterior in which 100% of the empirically supported vent states supply what carbon fixation needs, transport-class-independent, with the ledger exact (0 of 96 points rejected). So the campaign's result is a mechanism map and an honestly-advanced spine whose central transition is still open, not a declaration of success: a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds in a pore (Act II), self-amplification does not occur under vent conditions (A2 refuted, both routes), a membrane earns its cost on persistence (Act III qualified), and the protocell reproduces and inherits a selectable trait (Act IV qualified), with the Act V robustness/autonomy extension a mapped frontier rather than a demonstrated escape. The central scientific target the campaign now names is the emergence of reciprocal coupling - chemistry maintaining a boundary that, in turn, sustains and propagates that chemistry; endogenous autocatalysis is not demonstrated, and the chemistry-to-self-maintaining-individual transition is open. A single through-line runs across the independent mechanisms: robustness is the consistently hard-won and consistently traded axis - the pore, the membrane and the energy carrier each buy persistence/robustness not throughput, the ecology (og-ecology) is the counterpoint that buys throughput by spending robustness, and independence (og-independence) is an affordability map rather than a demonstrated escape. The honest caveats stay explicit (coarse budgets, lumped feeds, MD-informed not PMF-resolved, compositional not template heredity), each a named og-Na follow-up; the full gate-by-gate arc is in campaign-synthesis.md. What remains open is editorial (publication scope, bottleneck-map framing) and a few expert priors (the Hadean ocean's H2 / organic floor, heredity attachment thresholds, membrane permeabilities) - decisions, not unrun science.
executive.verdict_detail: Thirteen consolidated studies — the geochemistry-to-heredity arc, the nitrogen / phosphorus / energy / growth bottleneck modules, and an adversarial control — gather 36 run arms (the former calibration and -alt studies now folded as fidelities) across the five-act spine (its matched-null gates), wired into a DAG and all run. Each runs a coupled Vivarium composite of real tools (PHREEQC + FiPy; eQuilibrator; libRoadRunner; a FiPy thermal trap; amphiphile self-assembly; bioenergetic internalization; an agent-based heredity lineage; a pore metacommunity; an osmotic growth/division compartment; a Butler-Volmer galvanic cell) and is graded on its conservation and acceptance gates. Headline numbers: og-vent-environment holds the Lost City window (T 40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with |charge| = 0; og-carbon-fixation reproduces the Preiner/Hudson yields and shows the Tutolo arm halve the usable proton-motive gradient (427 -> 43 mV); og-network-persistence reaches a peak autocatalytic gain ~29.5 in its earlier reduced model - superseded under vent conditions by og-autocatalysis-a2's higher-fidelity refutation (Gate A2: autocatalysis refuted for both representable routes); og-heredity's compositional / hybrid heredity is seed-robust (0.878 +/- 0.005, 5/5 graded seeds); og-independence's {pump, importer, heredity} set is advantageous but driver-specific, not a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is required by no driver, the gradient the hard dependency — its withdrawal rescued by the full set in only ~4.2% of structures); og-vent-environment's Lost-City-conditioned posterior is 12.5% of the prior yet 100% viable downstream and transport-class-independent (ledger 0/96 rejected). og-carbon-fixation builds the vent wall as a Butler-Volmer cell in the Altair-2025 current window (7 of 8 gates pass, ledger exact on 750 runs) but its attribution gate fails at label agreement 0.47. The adversarial control is rejected by all five discriminating gates (min margin 1.8 decades) while the vent passes all five. The designed arc that sharpened this scaffold (og-vent-environment through og-independence) has now all run and merged on main; the central transition stays open. The spine lands Act II network persistence (A1, qualified) and spatial rescue (B, met), Act III self-compartmentation (C, qualified: og-self-compartmentation reduced-coupling ~2.9x and og-self-compartmentation MD-informed ~1.98x standing pool over a no-membrane ablation, with composition -> permeability -> retention resolved) and Act IV reproduction + heredity (D, qualified: og-reproduction metabolism-driven division at a measured area-doubling geometry, og-heredity parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control under selection), with endogenous autocatalysis refuted for both routes (A2, off-spine: og-autocatalysis-a2 formose seed-independent and -16.4 kJ/mol; og-autocatalysis-a2 reductive-TCA uphill +18/+31 kJ/mol under vent H2). The optional Act V extension has run and all qualified: og-energetics energy carrier (dip useful work 0.030 vs gradient-only 0.006 kJ/mol, total work NOT improved 0.256 vs 0.282, ledger closes ~9e-19); og-ecology ecology (community productivity ~1.9x over the best single lineage, cross-feeding-causal, but more variable with lineage loss at low counts - productivity-yes / robustness-no, the counterpoint); og-independence progressive independence (all three validated channels affordable to internalize, conditional on heredity and pump efficiency >~0.7 - an affordability / attribution map, not a demonstrated escape). Every gate is judged against a matched null with input fluxes held equal; the gold-standard follow-ups (og-32a/33a/34a/35a/36a/37a) are tracked, not hidden.
decisions_resolved: Baseline parameterization: run BOTH arms — classical favorable (Russell/Lane/Sojo) and the 2026 unfavorable reassessment (Tutolo/Jackson) — so the campaign adjudicates rather than assumes. Implemented in og-carbon-fixation.

Primary geochemistry engine: real PHREEQC (phreeqpython + vendored llnl.dat), which fields the Lost City pH endmember once peridotite (not dunite) is reacted. Reaktoro was conda-only and off the uv path.

Build order: geochemistry + transport first (og-vent-environment/og-carbon-fixation), then the reaction network (og-network-persistence) — not a thin end-to-end skeleton. This put a real composite in the workbench at stage 0.

Heredity strategy for og-heredity: compare all modules without presuming RNA. og-heredity's agent-based lineage grades RNA-like template, compositional (GARD), a template-focused hybrid and a non-heritable control head-to-head; compositional and hybrid heredity persist length-independently (functional persistence ~0.88, seed-robust 5/5 graded seeds) where a long low-fidelity template suffers the Eigen length catastrophe — so heredity need NOT presume a long high-fidelity RNA template.

Explicit electrochemistry for og-carbon-fixation: built, but not adopted as the gradient-efficiency abstraction — the carbon_fixation face adds a real Butler-Volmer galvanic-cell class (Nernst half-cells, Koutecky-Levich transport limits, Preiner electron branching), with MineralConductivityProcess deriving gradient_efficiency from the wall circuit and a ChargeLedger auditing the Kirchhoff/faradaic residuals. The empirical gradient-efficiency class is kept as og-carbon-fixation's graded default.

Carbon-fixation limitation attribution + default class (resolved by Eran): ACCEPT the structure-sensitive limitation attribution AS the carbon-fixation result — the empirical and Butler-Volmer classes disagreeing on the limitation label in the favorable region (agreement 0.47 < 0.8) IS the finding, reported as the og-carbon-fixation mechanism map with gate_status failed (an honest negative); the gate is not re-tuned to force a pass. KEEP empirical as og-carbon-fixation's graded/headline default and butler_volmer as the registered high-fidelity electrochemistry class (the same FiPy-grades / FEniCS-cross-checks pattern), revisiting butler_volmer as the headline once Altair per-condition data turns its calibration window into a fit.

Carbon-fixation follow-up (accepted, not done): attach the Altair-2025 per-condition current / product time courses (turning the calibration window into a likelihood) and bridge CatMAP/Cantera to run the microkinetic carbon_fixation class under pixi, then re-run the mechanism map with three classes. Deferred because the per-condition dataset is not yet in-workspace and the microkinetic backend needs a pixi env.

og-spatial-concentration retention gate (resolved by Eran): RESTATE it at the resolvable Peclet rather than the >=1e6 enrichment fold — the extreme fold is the closed-cell/reduced-model FiPy exp(Pe) figure the resolved FEM does not confirm above Pe ~ 13, so localization is gated on the Peclet, not the fold-magnitude. The gate change itself is implemented in a separate og-spatial-concentration PR; recorded here as the decision-state.

og-independence {pump, importer, heredity} required-set (resolved by the og-independence rebuild): the per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal resolves the attribution confound — the required innovation set is DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal triple. {pump, heredity} rescues the vent-pmf gradient (a hard dependency: the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral access (0.958) and feed (0.75) are freely/borderline survivable needing no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The earlier "no subset jointly sufficient / hypothesis generator" reading was the gradient's rarity dominating the lumped all-at-once collapse (og-independence is now gate_status passed / verdict qualified; confound_resolved, ledgers close). So the campaign's endpoint statement reads "driver-specific rescue, the vent drive the hard dependency," not "no subset sufficient." The ocean-floor H2/organic prior remains an open refinement (still in decisions_needed).

Campaign headline thesis (resolved): the campaign is framed as a quantitative map of the bottlenecks between geology and cells — where the path is physically continuous, where it depends on narrow regimes, and where it breaks — not as a demonstration that cells did originate at vents. The vent hypothesis stays the primary lens; this framing is now the executive summary (phase maps, feature ablations, negative controls and first-class negative results realize it).

Localization -> ignition coupling (resolved): run as og-network-rescue — at equal vent feed a concentrating pore ignites the full carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dark (Gate B, met). The earlier phantom in-pore ignition finding was retired and og-network-rescue carries the real coupled result.

Reporting standard (resolved): adopted the three-quantity standard — feasibility, robustness and discrimination — with evidence tiers. It lives in guidelines.scientific_standard, and each study carries an evidence_tier and reports the three quantities rather than a bare gate pass/fail.

Proto-energetics readout (resolved): per-individual autonomy, internal / (internal + external) power, is published beside og-energetics' population-mean internalization rather than switched in — both derive from the same per-strategy power terms, so the passing study keeps its original observable and gains the autonomy one.

decisions_needed.question: Ocean-floor H2 / organic prior (og-independence): supply an expert prior on the Hadean ocean's dissolved H2 and organic background (the off-gradient floor) to turn og-independence's floor map into a prediction.
decisions_needed.context: The floor (swept 1e-3 .. 1e-1) and the bioenergetic upkeep are the numbers the off-gradient verdict turns on. The {pump, heredity} required-set is resolved (driver-specific, see decisions_resolved); this prior is the remaining open piece.

decisions_needed.question: MARHYS 4.0 + Hadean-ocean prior (og-vent-environment): attach the MARHYS 4.0 hydrothermal-fluid compilation as a workspace dataset so the vent-calibration conditioning set becomes the ultramafic-vent population rather than Lost City alone, and choose the Hadean-ocean prior (DIC, pH, T) that replaces the modern-seawater proxy.
decisions_needed.context: The dissolved-H2 window is the binding observation (pH is mineral-buffered near 9.4 for every draw), and under full redox equilibrium DIC draws down before free H2 appears — so the H2 posterior depends most on the DIC prior and on the equilibrium-vs-kinetic carbon-redox choice, more than on any swept knob.

decisions_needed.question: Agent motion model (og-ecology follow-up): which motion model should the ecology follow-up adopt — none, advected with the pore flow, Brownian between cells, or thermophoretic like the solutes?
decisions_needed.context: Agents currently sit on fixed cells of the enrichment field, so mixed and segregated placements give the same community-only function (pore diffusion between cells mixes the exchanged intermediate); a motion model would make that mixing a property of the agents rather than of the field.

decisions_needed.question: Dicarboxylate membrane permeability (og-ecology): is a leakier boundary (mixed / shorter-chain amphiphiles) or a longer pore residence the defensible route for the cross-feeding C4 branch, or should the exchanged intermediate be a neutral species?
decisions_needed.context: Community function emerges only above a diacid permeability of ~3e-9 m/s at 100 s residence, while the measured passage of charged solutes through fatty-acid vesicles is ~1e-11 .. 1e-10 m/s — the canonical operating point sits inside the emergence region but above the measured range.

decisions_needed.question: Heredity attachment thresholds (og-heredity): what precursor-copy budget, energy margin and fidelity floor are defensible for attaching heredity to a lineage?
decisions_needed.context: The build sweeps the budget x fidelity space with hypothetical values (10 copies, margin 1.0, Eigen's Q >= 1/sigma as the fidelity floor). Expert input decides where the thresholds sit and whether the mineral class's defect-copy error (the number that makes mineral_state dominate the frontier) has a measured anchor.

decisions_needed.question: Reaction-universe rule-set scope: keep the C1-C3 C/H/O-only chemistry (as built) or fold N/P-bearing reactions in from the start so amino-acid / nucleotide-precursor motifs compete with formose?
decisions_needed.context: C/H/O keeps the first enrichment result on eQuilibrator-covered thermodynamics and a (C,O)-balanced null; N/P rules need N/P potentials, a redesigned null and N/P ledgers. Also open: whether branched skeletons (citrate) should be added so rTCA-type cycles can close.

decisions_needed.question: Unified-world architecture: adopt a single persistent-world composite with process-bigraph structural rewrites (boundary formation / division / extinction as _add/_remove/_divide on a map of individuals) and a model-class-as-axis registry as the build target, or keep the current separate-composite staging?
decisions_needed.context: The stages currently run as separate composites with hand-carried parameters and a division counter, so "a boundary forms" and "an individual divides" are scalar readouts rather than changes in the composition itself. A unified world would carry a conservation ledger across rewrites. Sequencing relative to the publication milestone is the open piece.

decisions_needed.question: Publication scope: close the first paper at the pre-genetic arc (og-vent-environment -> og-spatial- concentration) or extend through the early-genetic arc (og-self-compartmentation protocells -> og-heredity)?
decisions_needed.context: Every scope has run and passed, so all are available. The pre-genetic arc — a precipitating interface retaining a persistent protometabolic carbon flux, then localized individuals — is the tightest standalone story; extending adds membrane compartmentation, bioenergetic internalization and the heredity result, with ecology, escape and the C/N/P/energy/growth bottlenecks behind them. Editorial call.

scientific_argument.main_claim: On real geochemical and chemical engines, a serpentinization-fed alkaline vent-ocean interface supplies, in order, the free energy, reduced carbon, persistent network chemistry, concentration, compartmentation, internalized bioenergetics and heritable organization a protocell needs, each as an independently falsifiable nonequilibrium transition judged against a matched null. Read as five acts, the arc advances on persistence — spatial organization, retention and energy-buffering buy persistence and robustness, not productivity — while endogenous autocatalysis is tested and refuted under vent conditions, and an adversarial vent-ablated control is rejected by every discriminating gate, so the campaign adjudicates the vent mechanism rather than illustrating one story. The sharper contribution is where the higher-fidelity re-grounding breaks the easy story: the limiting step in carbon fixation is structure-sensitive, no autocatalysis emerges without a one-carbon feed, the prebiotic mixture fractionates instead of co-localizing, and og-independence's escape is driver-specific rather than a universally sufficient {pump, importer, heredity} triple. Each failure is a mapped parameter region and a discriminating prediction, not a dead end. The central scientific target is the emergence of reciprocal coupling — chemistry maintaining a boundary that, in turn, sustains and propagates that chemistry; that transition, and open-ended chemical evolvability, remain open.
evidence_for: H2-dependent mineral-catalyzed CO2 fixation (Preiner, Varma, Huber)
pH-gradient-driven CO2 reduction with isotope controls (Hudson, Altair)
thermophoretic concentration in pores (Baaske, Mast & Braun)
evidence_against: in-situ pH/sulfur/longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume (Tutolo 2026; Jackson 2016)
no validated vent pathway spans to open-ended heredity (Module J)
lab yields are not Hadean environmental concentrations

the chemically-necessary prebiotic mixture fractionates rather than co-localizing in a single thermophoretic pore (co-localization map; surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree after the reconciliation) — the fractionation is Soret-driven — low-S_T species such as ammonium lag the strongly-thermophoretic ones (adsorption is kinetically negligible over the transit), a candidate spatial incompatibility for assembling the set a protocell needs together
caveats: Every quantitative anchor is laboratory or field provenance, not a measured Hadean environmental concentration — the campaign tests whether each mechanism is feasible and where it fails, not that these exact values held on the early Earth.

A few headline magnitudes are solver-sensitive extrapolations, not resolved results — notably og-spatial-concentration's enrichment fold (the reduced FiPy accumulation column reaches ~10⁸-fold, 9.6×10⁷, at accumulation Péclet ≈ 18, where it diverges ~5.6 decades from the resolved FEniCS/dolfinx field above the Pe ≈ 13 the FEM resolves); the defensible claim there is that localization occurs and is bounded, not the exact fold-magnitude. The resolved 3-D flow-through FEM solve (the localization stage) shows single-pore enrichment is strongest at low Péclet and washes out as flow rises (1/(1+Pe/pe0)), so that extreme fold belongs to the convection-enhanced closed-cell (recirculating) regime, distinct from the resolved flow-through result.

The chemically-necessary prebiotic mixture does not all concentrate in the same place — the co-localization map finds the eight-solute mixture fractionates in a single thermophoretic pore, Soret-driven — the strongly-thermophoretic species concentrate while low-S_T species such as ammonium lag, holding the co-localization index low in the strong-Soret regime (~0.18, rising toward ~1 where the Soret contrast is weak). Adsorption is kinetically negligible over the pore transit (FEM mobile fraction 0.93–1.0), so it is not the cause. After the surrogate↔FEM reconciliation the surrogate and dolfinx FEM agree on both verdict and degree (within ~2–19%; coloc_index 0.176 vs 0.171 at Pe=1/×8). Reported as a candidate incompatibility, not a passed gate — concentration of one tracer is not concentration of the set a protocell needs together.

The stages currently run as separate composites with hand-carried parameters and a division counter rather than one persistent world whose bigraph restructures, so "a boundary forms" and "an individual divides" are scalar readouts, not changes in the composition itself.

key_claims.claim: Alkaline hydrothermal vents sustain a natural proton gradient across thin inorganic (Fe/Ni-sulfide) walls — a geologically free energy source a nascent cell could tap before evolving its own membrane and pumps.
Serpentinization of olivine delivers a sustained supply of H2, the reducing power that drives prebiotic chemistry at the vent.
That H2 reduces CO2 to organic carbon on native-metal and mineral catalysts without enzymes, reproducing the acetyl-CoA–like chemistry thought ancestral to life.
Nonenzymatic reaction networks (reductive-TCA fragments) can persist and self-amplify under continuous vent flow, a precursor to metabolism.
Thermal gradients in vent pores concentrate molecules by thermophoresis — a route to localized, individual-like accumulations against dilution.
Fatty-acid vesicles can assemble and persist under vent-like temperature and pH, giving the chemistry a compartment.
The classical favorable picture is contested — in-situ pH, sulfide availability and vent longevity may be far less favorable than classical models assume, so each step is run against that challenge.

studies.name: og-vent-environment
studies.title: The Vent Environment: Does It Supply a Viable Feed?
studies.question: Does a serpentinizing alkaline vent hold its empirical (Lost City) window across the operating grid and supply, in a calibrated posterior, the feed downstream chemistry needs?

findings.evidence_basis_note: The forward PHREEQC+FiPy reactor baseline settles inside the Lost City window - a prediction, distinct from the calibrated posterior findings.
findings.statement: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).
findings.explanation: Real PHREEQC peridotite serpentinization (Ca-OH endmember) + FiPy transport; pH is a genuine speciation result, not tuned.

findings.statement: Serpentinization delivers a sustained H2 reducing-power flux (min 2.75e-4 mol/s over the back half of the run).

evidence.observed: 2.75e-4 mol/s

findings.statement: PHREEQC charge balance is conserved exactly (|charge|=0) and the FiPy FVM spatial-flux divergence is held to 4.9e-5 — within the 1e-3 contract tolerance (not machine epsilon).

evidence.observed: |charge|=0, |flux residual|=4.9e-5 (within 1e-3 tol)

findings.statement: The Lost City pH endmember required reacting PERIDOTITE (olivine+pyroxene), not dunite — Ca released once Mg is consumed buffers the fluid to pH ~9.5.
findings.explanation: Olivine-only buffers at ~7.8 (brucite); adding diopside gives the Ca-OH endmember that reproduces field pH.

findings.statement: The vent wall convects. Solving Darcy–Boussinesq porous flow (a stream-function Poisson ∇²ψ = −buoyancy·∂T/∂x on the real FiPy mesh) gives a buoyant recirculation cell — the hot alkaline conduit rises, the cold ocean sinks, convective velocities ~5× the background upflow (Peclet ~8) — rather than a prescribed uniform upflow. The recirculation mixes cold ocean inward, settling the outlet ~8 °C cooler (59 → 51 °C) while staying inside the Lost City window; flux conservation is preserved within the solver tolerance (flux residual ~5e-5, within the 1e-3 bound).

evidence.observed: recirculation cell (cold-left sinks, hot-right rises); vmax ~5× background; outlet 50.6 °C

findings.explanation: FipyReactiveTransportProcess now solves the stream function each step and advects T + solute with the divergence-free Darcy velocity (u=∂ψ/∂y, v=−∂ψ/∂x + upflow); ψ contours are the streamlines the cross-section viz overlays. buoyancy=0 recovers the old constant upflow.

findings.statement: Habitability is a bounded REGION of the (olivine reaction rate × flow velocity) operating space, not one tuned run — the real PHREEQC + FiPy vent settles inside the Lost City window (T 40–91 °C AND pH 9.0–10.8 AND H2>0) over ~80% of the swept grid (115/144 points). The FAIL regions are a cold-washout band at the fastest flow (17 cold points) and 12 points at the flow extreme that fall outside PHREEQC's 0–100 °C validity (recorded NaN → FAIL); the baseline operating point sits safely inside the window.

evidence.observed: 115/144 (80%) habitable over (olivine_rate 0.005–0.4 × flow_velocity 2e-4–3e-2); 17 cold-washout FAILs, 12 out-of-range NaN; baseline (★) in-window at 50.6 °C / pH 9.37

findings.explanation: The vent_habitability_phase_map sweeps the real serpentinizing reactor and reduces each point to the habitability PASS flag (settled outlet in-window with a positive H2 flux); rendered as the Lost City habitability map (Decision view). Enough serpentinization to drive H2 + alkalinity and slow enough flow to hold 40–91 °C / pH 9.0–10.8 bounds the habitable band.
findings.next_action: Sweep pyroxene_fraction (ol/px ratio) and seawater-mixing dilution to bound the pH endmember (og-00b).

findings.evidence_basis_note: A Bayesian posterior fitted to the Lost City T/pH/H2 field windows.
findings.statement: Feasibility and robustness, in the plan's sense: 6/48 prior draws (12.5%) settle inside every Lost City window, and 6/6 of those (posterior-viable fraction 1.00) also satisfy og-01's requirements — dissolved H2 >= 1 mM at the interface, pH gradient >= 3 units against pH 6.0, T <= 100 C. One supporting parameterization: flow 3.2e-4 m/s, olivine_rate 0.38, pyroxene 0.54, fe 0.26, heat partition 6.2e-4, DIC 1.4 mM -> 49.2 C, pH 9.38, H2 10.8 mmol/kg, delta pH 3.38.

evidence.observed: consistent 6/48; viable|consistent 1.00 (both transport classes)

findings.explanation: ABC rejection on the vg-data windows (outlet T 40-91 C; pH 9.0-10.8; H2 1-15 mmol/kg) over a 48-point Latin-hypercube prior of the six free parameters of the real PHREEQC + FiPy world, then the downstream-requirement mask on the accepted set. Artifact: artifacts/vent_environment_report.json.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The DIC posterior is narrowed by conditioning on the Lost City H2 window.
findings.statement: The dissolved-H2 window binds: 48/48 draws pass the pH window, 47/48 the temperature window, only 6/48 the H2 window (39 fall below 1 mmol/kg, 3 above 15). The posterior narrows the inflowing DIC from the prior 1.2-17 mM to 1.2-2.9 mM and pushes the reaction extent high (olivine_rate 0.09-0.38 vs prior 0.02-0.35), with fe_fraction 0.14-0.26. Mechanism: at full redox equilibrium in llnl.dat the Fe(II) budget first reduces the fluid's DIC (toward CH4 — Lost City's abiogenic methane); free dissolved H2 appears only once that carbon sink is exhausted, so H2 is a threshold in (fe_fraction x olivine_rate) / DIC, not a smooth function of the Fe budget.

evidence.observed: per-observation acceptance pH 48/48, T 47/48, H2 6/48; DIC posterior q05-q95 1.2-2.9 mM vs prior 1.2-17 mM

findings.explanation: Direct PHREEQC probe: at olivine_rate 0.15 / DIC 2 mM, fe 0.25 gives 4.6 mmol/kg H2 (pe -9.6) while fe 0.10 gives 0 (pe -7.4); raising DIC to 15 mM at fe 0.25 also gives 0. This is an equilibrium-model statement: a kinetic (non-equilibrium) carbon-redox class on the serpentinization face would shift the threshold — recorded as the structural uncertainty to test next (Reaktoro / PFLOTRAN; decision in the investigation).

findings.statement: Outlet pH is 9.38-9.91 for every one of the 96 runs regardless of flow, reaction extent, DIC or Fe budget — the peridotite (Ca-OH / tremolite-diopside) assemblage buffers it, so the pH observation accepts the whole prior and carries no information about the parameters. Morris mu* for pH is <= 0.11 on every parameter (vs 23 for H2 on olivine_rate). og-00's "pH in window" gate is therefore a reproduction of the buffer, not a constraint on the vent's operating point.

evidence.observed: pH range 9.38-9.91 over 96 runs; mu*(pH) <= 0.108; pH window accepts 48/48

findings.statement: Discrimination, in the plan's sense: the convecting (Darcy-Boussinesq) and prescribed-uniform-upflow FiPy classes agree on consistency and viability for 48/48 identical draws (structure agreement 1.00, model-form uncertainty 0.00). They are told apart only by outlet temperature (paired standardised difference d = 0.89; convection settles ~2 C warmer at nx = 20), not by pH (d = -0.54 at a 0.02-unit scale), dissolved H2 (d = 0.00) or pe (0.06). Whether the wall convects is a structural choice og-00's conclusions do not depend on.

evidence.observed: agreement 1.00 on viability; d(T) = 0.89, d(H2) = 0.00

findings.explanation: Same 48 draws run through model_spatial_transport = fipy and fipy_uniform_upflow (buoyancy 0); the serpentinization source is identical, and the outlet pH/H2 are set by speciation, not by the wall's flow pattern. The FEniCS class (a merged dolfinx alternative, run under viva-fenics's pixi env) is a third available class on this axis, held out of this uv-.venv ensemble — not a forthcoming addition.

findings.statement: Morris screening (r = 4 trajectories, 28 world runs): dissolved H2 is controlled by olivine_rate (mu* 23.0), fluid DIC (20.8) and flow (16.9), weakly by fe_fraction (3.1), not at all by pyroxene fraction or heat partition; outlet temperature by the heat-partition fraction (2.16), flow (1.47) and olivine_rate (0.84). The two conditioning readouts that carry information (T, H2) are controlled by disjoint parameters, so the posterior factorises: T pins heat_to_fluid_fraction, H2 pins the Fe-budget-to-DIC ratio.

evidence.observed: mu*(H2): olivine_rate 23.0, fluid_dic 20.8, flow 16.9, fe 3.1; mu*(T): heat_to_fluid 2.16, flow 1.47, olivine 0.84

findings.explanation: Elementary effects on the log-scaled prior bounds of the vg-data package; artifact ensemble.morris.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the ConservationLedgerProcess closes exactly on all 96 ensemble runs and on the 120-tick canonical run — integrated H2 / alkalinity / heat sources equal the accumulated pools bit-for-bit (residual 0.0), PHREEQC charge imbalance 0, FiPy flux-divergence residual <= 1.1e-14, and serpentinization heat is released, never absorbed (energy_directionality 1). No prior draw was rejected by PHREEQC (0 failed points), so the posterior is not truncated by engine validity.

evidence.observed: mass residual 0.0; energy residual 0.0; charge 0; flux <= 1.1e-14; 0/96 failed

findings.explanation: The og-00 contract's four invariants (mass_balance, charge_neutrality, spatial_flux_conservation, energy_directionality) are now all machine-witnessed; energy_directionality was previously declared but not computed.

studies.claim: A serpentinizing alkaline vent holds its Lost City window (T 40-91 C, pH 9.0-10.8, positive H2 flux) over ~80% of the swept grid with |charge|=0, and conditioning on that window leaves a posterior 12.5% of the prior in which 100% of empirically supported vent states supply what downstream carbon fixation needs — transport-class-independent, ledger 0/96 rejected. Supported, bounded.

derived.insight: Outlet settles at 50.6 °C and pH 9.37 — both inside the Lost City field window (40–91 °C, 9.0–10.8).

studies.name: og-carbon-fixation
studies.title: Carbon Fixation: Does H2 Reduce CO2 at the Vent?
studies.question: Does H2-driven CO2 reduction over Fe/Ni/S catalysts fix carbon and reproduce lab yield benchmarks at the vent — and can the model classes agree on which limitation stops it?

findings.statement: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.

evidence.observed: label coverage 1.00 (empirical), 1.00 (butler_volmer); 0/750 failed points

findings.explanation: The Butler-Volmer class partitions the fresh-fluid emf into product back-pressure (thermodynamic), ohmic drop (electrical), activation overpotential (catalytic) and concentration overpotential (transport) — four fractions that sum to one while current flows — and takes the largest (a cathode sending most electrons to H2 is catalytic / selectivity-limited). The empirical class publishes the headroom of each of its multiplicative gates (1 - feasible, 1 - drive(pmf), 1 - catalyst x Ni gain, 1 - availability). Artifact: artifacts/electrochemistry_mechanism_map.json.

findings.statement: The pre-registered failure-mode-attributed gate fails: on the 78 points both classes call favorable the labels agree on 37 (0.47); overall 168/375 (0.45). The confusion is systematic, not noise — every Butler-Volmer favorable point is catalytic (93/93), while the empirical class calls 47 of its favorable points electrical and 28 transport. Agreement is high only where the physics is unambiguous: 0.81 at 1e-9 S/m (both: electrical) and 0.67-0.68 at H2 >= 1.4e-4 M; it collapses to 0.01 at 1 uM H2, where the empirical Michaelis constant (1e-4 M) declares transport limitation that the cell never reaches (the limiting current stays above the activation-limited current at these exchange currents).

evidence.observed: label agreement 0.474 on 78 favorable-both points (gate >= 0.8); 0.448 overall; favorability structure agreement 0.65

findings.explanation: The empirical rate law's drive(pmf) = pmf / (pmf + 0.08 V) lumps the delivered gradient (electrical) and the electrode kinetics (catalytic) into one saturating term, so its "electrical" headroom in the favorable region is what the Butler-Volmer class resolves as activation overpotential. Paired class differences on identical points: loss_transport d = 1.77, loss_thermodynamic d = 0.68 (discriminating); loss_electrical, loss_catalytic and gradient_efficiency |d| < 0.5 (not discriminating). decision_discipline flags the attribution as structure-sensitive.

findings.statement: Under explicit electrochemistry the alkaline-vent cell is catalytically (activation) limited everywhere the wall conducts: at the nominal point (pH 9.5 | 6.0, 5 mM H2, 2 mM CO2, 100 C, 1e-3 S/m, Ni3Fe) the anode + cathode activation overpotentials take 0.996 of the 0.49 V fresh-fluid emf, the ohmic drop 0.002 and transport 0.001, at j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2 with faradaic efficiency 0.92 to carbon. Throughput rises only ~40x across the whole (pH x H2) plane (74 mV per pH unit, (RT/2F) ln10 per decade of H2) because the current scales with the exchange current, not the driving force. The electrical regime appears below ~1e-6 S/m (ohmic drop > activation), where the circuit-derived gradient efficiency is 0.01-0.42.

evidence.observed: nominal losses: catalytic 0.996, electrical 0.002, transport 0.001, thermodynamic 0.0; j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; FE 0.92; gradient_efficiency 0.01 / 0.42 / 0.98 / 1.00 at 1e-9 / 1e-7 / 1e-5 / 1e-3 S/m

findings.explanation: Exchange currents calibrated to the Altair-2025 current window (j0_co2 1e-5, j0_h2 5e-5, j0_her 2.5e-6 A/m^2 at Ni3Fe, 100 C) are small, so the Butler-Volmer branches need ~0.2-0.3 V each to carry 1e-3 A/m^2; the mineral + ionic path drops microvolts unless the wall is an insulator. This is a prediction under the calibration, not a measurement: the per-condition Altair currents are not yet attached.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The Butler-Volmer settled current density lands inside the independent Altair-2025 window; it is not fit to that window.
findings.statement: The Butler-Volmer class's settled current density lies inside the Altair-2025 window (1e-5 .. 1e-2 A/m^2, i.e. ~10 nA .. 10 uA on the cm^2-scale interface) at the canonical operating point and on 79.7% of the grid (range 1.4e-7 .. 3.0e-3 A/m^2; the points below the window are the insulating walls). Selectivity to carbon products stays 0.76-1.00.

evidence.observed: canonical j = 1.06e-3 A/m^2; grid fraction in window 0.797; FE 0.76-1.00

findings.explanation: Reproduction-tier check against the calibration window (vg-data electrochemical_interface.observations.cell_current_density); the window is the dossier summary, not a per-condition fit.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the ChargeLedgerProcess closes on all 750 mechanism-map runs and on the 120-tick canonical run — Kirchhoff residual |anode - (carbon + H2 evolution)| / anode <= 1.7e-13 (0.0 for the empirical class), faradaic efficiency never above 1 (max 1 + 1e-13), circuit residual <= 8.5e-9. The ledger caught a real bookkeeping gap during the build (on insulating walls the trace ocean-side H2 oxidising at the cathode co-supplies electrons), which is now counted explicitly.

evidence.observed: charge residual <= 1.7e-13; FE max 1.0000000000001; iv residual <= 8.5e-9; 0/750 failed

findings.evidence_basis_note: The absolute C1-C3 yields are anchored to the Preiner-2020 hierarchy they reproduce.
findings.statement: The favorable arm reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate 200 mM >> acetate 100 µM >> pyruvate 10 µM) at 100 °C.

evidence.observed: formate=200 mM, acetate=100 µM, pyruvate=10 µM

findings.explanation: Real eQuilibrator ΔG'-gated, lab-calibrated mineral kinetics over the pH gradient.

findings.statement: Formate is present with the pH-gradient proton-motive force and collapses to <1 mM in every control (no gradient / no H2 / no catalyst).

evidence.observed: favorable 200 mM; all controls <1 mM

findings.evidence_basis_note: The pmf collapse is the model's response under the independent Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm.
findings.statement: The Tutolo-2026 in-situ arm collapses the usable proton-motive gradient (pmf 427 → 43 mV), the discriminating test the campaign must survive.

evidence.observed: favorable pmf 427 mV vs Tutolo 43 mV

findings.explanation: Real FiPy Nernst-Planck electrodiffusion with a gradient_efficiency knob (1.0 favorable, 0.1 Tutolo).

findings.statement: Real eQuilibrator ΔG' is logged every step and makes feasibility explicit (fixation stops where ΔG' ≥ 0 — genuine product inhibition).

Carbon fixation SPENDS the proton gradient — a conserved proton budget (≈2 H⁺ per carbon) draws the loaded pmf down ~40% below the open-circuit 427 mV under load, then relaxes as products saturate. The gradient does work and is consumed, not merely correlated with reduction.

evidence.observed: pmf open-circuit 427 mV sags to ~250 mV (charge 0.60) at peak fixation, recovers to 427 mV

findings.explanation: A ProtonBudgetProcess integrates reservoir = supply − protons_per_carbon·carbon_flux − leak·reservoir; fixation reads the loaded pmf = pmf_open·(reservoir/capacity), closing the respiratory-control feedback.

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over the (vent pH × dissolved H₂) plane maps the carbon-fixation landscape, not a single run. In the open-flow reactor, sustained reduced-carbon throughput scales with both the pH gradient and H₂ (6.4 → 24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s; steady pool 7–28 mM); the Tutolo-2026 gradient collapse roughly halves it on the same axes, and the no-gradient / no-catalyst / no-H₂ controls zero it. The favorable region is broadly productive — the sharp dependence is on a SUSTAINED gradient, not on sitting at one pH/H₂ point.

evidence.observed: favorable 6.4–24 ×10⁻³ mol-C/s vs Tutolo 2.2–15; controls 0

findings.explanation: 14×14 sweep of the real open-flow composite (pH 7–11 × H₂ 0.1–20 mM, exponential washout) reduced to sustained throughput per point; rendered as the carbon-fixation phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phase_grid.py.

studies.claim: H2-driven CO2 reduction fixes carbon at the vent. Over Fe/Ni/S catalysts the model reproduces the Preiner-2020 yield hierarchy (formate ~200 mM >> acetate ~100 uM >> pyruvate ~10 uM) and sustains net organic-carbon flux in a bounded pH-gradient x dissolved-H2 region; formate collapses to <1 mM in every no-gradient / no-H2 / no-catalyst control, and carbon fixation spends the proton gradient (~2 H+/carbon, chemiosmotic backpressure) (og-01, canonical, supported). Under explicit electrochemistry the vent cell is activation (catalyst) limited where the wall conducts and its current sits in the Altair-2025 window, but the two model classes agree on the dominant-limitation label on only 47% of the favorable region (below the pre-registered 80% gate), so the limitation attribution is structure-sensitive and og-01-cal-electrochemistry is refuted on that agreement question (og-01-cal, refuted; og-01-cal-dx planned to diagnose). Consolidated headline: supported — carbon fixation works and reproduces lab benchmarks; the mechanistic attribution of its rate-limiting step is not yet model-class-robust. Every matched null and arm verdict kept, including the refutation.

derived.insight: Every one of the 375 grid points carries a limitation label in both runnable classes (coverage 1.00; 0 failed runs). Butler-Volmer: catalytic 226, electrical 149, transport 0, thermodynamic 0. Empirical: transport 147, catalytic 117, electrical 108, thermodynamic 3.
