studies.title: Network Persistence: Does the Carbon-Fixing Network Sustain Itself?
studies.question: Under continuous vent-realistic feed and washout, does the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persist and sustain net carbon throughput as a connected system — and does it do so by endogenous autocatalytic amplification or merely by sustained driven flux — each arm tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?

findings.statement: The measured tier reproduces the nonenzymatic metal-promoted carbon-fixation and reverse-Krebs-like segments from the primary literature as balanced, source-keyed records (metal- promoted rTCA sequences; Fe-driven synthesis/breakdown of universal precursors; native-iron CO2 reduction to acetyl-CoA-pathway intermediates).

The inferred tier extends connectivity from C1–C3 to functional products only where eQuilibrator ΔG feasibility holds and a justified rate form/range is attached, each flagged is_range with its thermodynamic model recorded — no inferred reaction is promoted without that explicit basis.

No record with mass_balanced=false, charge_balanced=false, or a missing source_key enters atlas.vN.jsonl — the deterministic validator rejects it at write time. This zero-leakage guarantee is the study's core deliverable.
Candidate energy-coupling and Fe–S / UV-driven steps relevant to downstream energy carriers (study 35) are catalogued with their experimental anchors and confidence tiers.
The atlas emits the 28→29 transfer bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the typed reaction set study 29 consumes.

At the vent posterior feed the rule-generated universe (121 species, 413 reversible reactions, C <= 4) sustains 14 persistent species and a net CO2 fixation of 2.2e-5 mol/s but contains NO persistent autocatalytic motif (0 flux-carrying simple cycles with gain > 1); all 24 matched nulls also contain 0. The rTCA reductive branch pyruvate -> OAA -> malate -> succinate appears from the rules at 5e-8 / 9e-8 / 8e-9 M — three orders below og-02's curated 2 mM OAA — because pyruvate carboxylation at 1.4 mM CO2 sits at its equilibrium (dG'0 = -1.1 kJ/mol -> [OAA]/[pyruvate] = K [CO2] = 2e-3) rather than being driven irreversibly.

evidence.observed: universe 0 motifs, 14 persistent species, malate 8.8e-8 M; nulls 0/24; p = 1.0

findings.explanation: Every C-C bond-forming route is uphill at vent concentrations: reductive carboxylation of formate / acetate (+7.7 / +30.6 kJ/mol standard, +50 kJ/mol at the actual mM / 10 mM activities) and the aldehyde route (formate + H2 -> formaldehyde, +28 kJ/mol; [CH2O]eq = 3e-10 M). The universe is dissipative (0.88 W/L) but its flux is C1 reduction and pyruvate decay. Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm phase1_feed).

findings.evidence_basis_note: The single autocatalytic motif emerges from the reaction rules and beats 24 matched nulls (p=0.040); the vent posterior feeds are calibrated inputs, tracked in the reaction_universe provenance audit.
findings.statement: With 10 mM formaldehyde added to the same feed, exactly one persistent autocatalytic motif emerges from the rules and is recovered post hoc: glycolaldehyde + CH2O -> glyceraldehyde -> dihydroxyacetone (+ CH2O) -> erythrulose -> erythrose -> 2 glycolaldehyde — the formose cycle (stoichiometric gain 2, dynamic gain 3.1 > 1, core of 5 species, 49 persistent species). 0 of 24 degree-preserving, (C,O)-matched null networks contain any motif: empirical p = 0.040 (1/25). The 6x6 ignition map (0.1-30 mM CH2O x 0.001-0.2/s washout; 3 nulls per cell, all 0) shows the motif only at formaldehyde >= 9.6 mM with washout >= 0.024/s, or 30 mM with washout >= 0.008/s (dynamic gain up to 18): at longer residence times the H2 reduction of formaldehyde and glycolaldehyde (k_reduce [H2] = 0.1/s) outruns the aldol propagation, and the gain falls below 1 again at 0.2/s where washout wins.

evidence.observed: universe 1 motif (gain 2, dynamic 3.1); nulls 0/24; p = 0.040; curated 1 motif (imposed)

findings.explanation: No rule names a cycle; the detector enumerates flux-carrying simple cycles with stoichiometric gain > 1 (Blokhuis 2020 type-I cores) from the doubling edges, identically for every class. The formose cycle closes through the retro-aldol of erythrose (the only doubling edge the chemistry provides at C <= 4). Artifact: artifacts/motif_enrichment.json (arm formose_feed, ignition_map).

findings.statement: Graded by the same detector, og-02's curated rTCA class shows one motif — the self-loop OAA + 2 CO2 -> 2 OAA + acetate — with dynamic gain 2.99, exactly its declared k_rtca [CO2] / k_wash, so the og-02 "autocatalytic gain" was a property written into the network, not an emergent one. The element ledger over its SBML finds the lumped turn creates 4 C, 8 H and 3 O per turn (6 C in, 10 C out), so og-02's net carbon throughput (6e-4 mol/s) counts carbon that was never fed. The curated class remains the fastest and richest in product, and the least conserving, of the three.

evidence.observed: element residual C 4 / H 8 / O 3 (max 8); detector gain 2.99 = declared 2.99

findings.explanation: og-02's finding og02-autocatalysis already said the motif was a curated lumped reaction; this study makes the consequence quantitative and machine-witnessed. The curated result keeps its PASS in og-02 (its gates do not include conservation) but is reclassed here as the imposed class.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: the universe is element-balanced by construction (max|E S| = 0 over 413 reactions, exact), the integrated carbon balance closes to 2.8e-6 (CVODE rtol 1e-6), dissipation -sum v dG is non-negative on every tick (0.88 W/L at the vent feed, 16 W/L in the formose arm), the MCA summation theorem holds to 3.3e-3 on the six dominant fluxes (1.3e-4 on the curated model), the Jacobian stiffness ratio is 9.4e2 (universe) / 4.8e3 (null), and tightening the tolerances to rtol 1e-9 changes no species by more than 7e-6 relative (loosening to 1e-3 changes the worst by 2.8e-3). The (C,O)-matched nulls fail the element ledger on hydrogen (residual 8-12) by construction.

evidence.observed: element 0; carbon 2.8e-6; dissipation_min >= 0; FCC summation 3.3e-3; tol sensitivity 7.0e-6

findings.explanation: Kinetics use the exergonic-direction class rate (k_down = k0, k_up = k0 exp(-|dG'0|/RT)), so detailed balance holds exactly and no rate exceeds a catalyst's turnover; the dissipation witness is therefore a real second-law check, not an identity. Artifacts: artifacts/reaction_universe_verification.json; the canonical run's ledger/* readouts.

findings.statement: The vg-data package reaction_universe carries 0 measured, 2 calibrated (the vent posterior feeds), 4 inferred, 7 extrapolated and 8 hypothetical parameters: every rate constant is an order-of-magnitude tick-scale number with a loguniform prior, swept rather than fitted. 50 of 121 skeletons resolve to a formula-verified KEGG compound and carry the live eQuilibrator component-contribution dG' (reaction dG' reproduced to 1e-6 kJ/mol); the other 71 carry a group-additivity estimate fitted to those (leave-one-out RMSE 7.2 kJ/mol).

evidence.observed: audit counts measured 0 / calibrated 2 / inferred 4 / extrapolated 7 / hypothetical 8; 50 resolved, 71 estimated

findings.explanation: The package is the honesty indicator the investigation asks for; its weakest entries are the rule rate constants, which is why the result is reported as an ignition region rather than a point.

findings.statement: The rTCA-fragment network sustains a nonzero net carbon throughput (~9e-4 mol/s) under continuous feed + washout, with no imposed product accumulation.

evidence.observed: 9e-4 mol/s

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner SBML CSTR — throughput is a steady balance of production and washout.

findings.statement: INVALIDATED (element-unbalanced curated motif): an apparent autocatalytic gain peaks at 29.5 (graded; settling as CO₂ limits) via a curated, element-lumped reductive-TCA turn whose lumped step is NOT mass-balanced (it creates 4 C/cycle), so the gain is an artifact; a no-CO₂ control collapses it to 0 — the gain is feed-driven and the motif is an imposed, element-unbalanced lumped stoichiometry, NOT genuine endogenous self-amplification. The campaign's dedicated discriminator (og-29, Gate A2) tests self-amplification against a degree-preserving matched null with a seed-independence test and refutes it; this finding therefore records an apparent, feed-driven gain, superseded on the self-amplification question by og-29.

evidence.observed: peak autocatalytic gain 29.5; no-CO2 control gain 0

findings.explanation: The reductive-TCA turn OAA+2CO2->2OAA+acetate doubles its own entry molecule per turn; the autocatalytic stoichiometry is a curated lumped reaction, so what is EMERGENT is that it sustains ignition under continuous feed + washout (a no-CO2 control collapses gain to 0), not the motif itself.

findings.statement: Products form ONE connected reaction network (networkx connectivity), not disconnected one-offs.

evidence.observed: connected=1.0

findings.statement: A sweep over (feed CO₂ × washout rate) maps where the network IGNITES, not just that it does at one point. The autocatalytic hub (OAA) persists in a sharply bounded region — enough geological CO₂ in, slow enough washout (gain > 1) — and collapses to zero across a clean diagonal boundary when the feed is starved or the reactor flushed too fast. The favorable operating point sits well inside the ignition region; the gain=1 contour is the autocatalytic threshold.

evidence.observed: OAA hub 0 → 24 mM across the (feed × washout) plane; ignition bounded by gain=1

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled OAA pool, net throughput and gain; rendered as the ignition phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_gain_grid.py. Per-reaction fluxes are now read live from the engine (getReactionRates) so the network view is flux-weighted.

studies.claim: Across fidelities the prebiotic carbon-fixing network persists — it sustains net carbon throughput as a connected system under vent-realistic feed + washout (og-02, canonical, supported) — but its persistence is driven, not autocatalytic self-amplification. Graded by a common detector, og-02's curated rTCA motif is imposed and element-unbalanced (the apparent gain an artifact); the rule-generated open universe (121 species, 413 balanced reactions) sustains a 14-species persistent network with NO autocatalytic motif at the vent feed, because every C-C-forming route is uphill, and the single motif that emerges (formose) requires an exogenous formaldehyde feed the vent chemistry does not make (og-02-alt, supported, p=0.04 vs 24 matched nulls). A versioned, provenance-tracked reaction atlas with a zero-leakage write gate supplies the balanced, confidence-tiered reactions both arms draw on (og-28, supported). Consolidated headline: supported — the network persists; endogenous autocatalysis is refuted at vent feed and tracked as the og-autocatalysis line. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.

derived.insight: The measured tier reproduces the nonenzymatic metal-promoted carbon-fixation and reverse-Krebs-like segments from the primary literature as balanced, source-keyed records (metal- promoted rTCA sequences; Fe-driven synthesis/breakdown of universal precursors; native-iron CO2 reduction to acetyl-CoA-pathway intermediates).

studies.name: og-spatial-concentration
studies.title: Spatial Concentration: Does a Pore Enrich a Dilute Feed?
studies.question: Does a serpentinite pore concentrate a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold, and does the chemically-necessary multi-solute set co-localize or fractionate?

findings.evidence_basis_note: The accumulation Peclet from the FVM transport model clears the independent Baaske-2007 regime; it is not fit to it.
findings.statement: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime at accumulation Péclet 18.4 from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon. The corresponding fold-enrichment (reduced-model exp(Pe) ≈ 1e6–1e7, nominally ~9.6×10⁷) is an extrapolation whose magnitude is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — the graded quantity is the Péclet, not the precise fold.

evidence.observed: favorable Pe_acc 18.4 (reduced-model fold-estimate ~1e6–1e7); FVM residual ~2e-14

findings.explanation: ThermophoreticTrapProcess solves the steady accumulation column; the Péclet is the resolved readout, while the fold-enrichment = exp(beta·L) is a reduced-model extrapolation. A FiPy↔FEniCS head-to-head cross-check finds the two solvers diverge by up to ~5.6 decades at Pe ≳ 13, so the extreme fold-magnitude is not treated as a precise resolved result.

findings.statement: The native pore-localization phase map (porosity × pore length) resolves localization as a bounded region, not a single favourable/open pair: the real trap localizes above the frontier (Péclet ≈ 18, reduced-model fold ≥ 1e6) at 25/144 grid points (~17%), enrichment rising with pore length, while an open pore (porosity→1) and a 10× shorter pore wash the feed through (no localization). The map is native to og-03's own trap readouts — it no longer borrows og-02's feed/washout axes. Localization (an individual forms vs washes through) is robust; the precise fold-magnitude in the high-Péclet interior is solver-sensitive (see limitations).

evidence.observed: 25/144 (17%) localized over (porosity 0.05–0.95 × pore length 5e-4–8e-3 m); open-pore does not concentrate (~1×), 10× shorter pore ~6× — both far below the frontier

findings.explanation: Enrichment rises with pore length and vanishes with confinement/openness — the dilution/localization boundary the campaign sought, read from the real FiPy accumulation solve and rendered as the pore-localization map (Decision view). The frontier LOCATION is robust; the fold-values deep in the high-Péclet interior are a reduced-model extrapolation.

studies.claim: A serpentinite pore concentrates a dilute vent feed above the dilution/retention threshold (Baaske regime cleared, accumulation Peclet 18.4) while an open-pore control washes through; but the chemically-necessary eight-solute set fractionates (Soret-driven, co-localization index ~0.18) rather than co-localizing — a candidate spatial incompatibility. Supported, bounded.

derived.insight: A favorable serpentinite pore (5 mm × 0.1 mm, ΔT 30 K, convective flow) clears the Baaske-2007 extreme-accumulation regime at accumulation Péclet 18.4 from the real thermophoretic + convective transport, with FVM flux conserved to machine epsilon. The corresponding fold-enrichment (reduced-model exp(Pe) ≈ 1e6–1e7, nominally ~9.6×10⁷) is an extrapolation whose magnitude is solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13 — the graded quantity is the Péclet, not the precise fold.

studies.name: og-energetics
studies.title: Proto-Energetics: Can a System Capture and Couple Free Energy?
studies.question: Can a primitive chemical system capture geochemical free energy, internalize it under selection, and couple a specified carrier to perform endergonic work — and does any of it improve total throughput, or only persistence/robustness — each tested against a matched null with a closing ledger?
methods: thioester carrier cycle with a closed free-energy ledger
matched gradient-only control (direct drive->work, no store)

findings.statement: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

evidence.observed: charged fraction 0.00 -> 0.39 and held under load

findings.explanation: ProtoEnergyCurrencyProcess charges the carrier at the coupling efficiency when the drive ΔG clears the carrier bond, discharges it to endergonic work under load, and bleeds it by first-order hydrolysis; the steady charge is the balance of charging against the two drains.

findings.evidence_basis_note: Stored-work fraction comes from the closed free-energy ledger, not fit to a target.
findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by DESTINATION (a conserved ledger: input = useful work + stored + dissipated) shows ~47% of the tapped geochemical free energy is captured as transferable usable work at the favourable operating point, the remaining ~53% dissipated (uncoupled drive, discharge inefficiency, hydrolysis). Capture is not assumed — it is measured, bounded, and falls off smoothly as the coupling efficiency or the drive margin over the carrier bond declines.

evidence.observed: stored-work fraction 0.47 of input free energy; ledger residual ~1e-16 kJ/L

findings.explanation: The currency process emits the full ledger (input / work / stored / dissipated); the stored-work fraction is (work + stored)/input. Charging draws bond/efficiency of input per charged mole (the uncoupled remainder dissipated), so the captured fraction is bounded above by the coupling efficiency and reduced further by discharge loss and hydrolysis — rendered as the energy-provenance panel (Mechanism) and the capture landscape (Decision).

findings.statement: The currency collapses under either ablation — no coupling (efficiency -> 0) OR a drive ΔG below the carrier's high-energy bond — so capturing environmental free energy into a transferable store requires BOTH a coupling chemistry and a drive strong enough to clear the bond. The drive axis has a real thermodynamic gate, not merely a rate dependence; the Decision phase map is the bounded region where both conditions hold.

evidence.observed: favourable charged fraction 0.39 vs no-coupling 0.00 / no-drive 0.00

findings.explanation: A carrier can only be charged when the drive ΔG exceeds the bond energy (a weak drive cannot charge a high-energy carrier) and the coupling actually transfers it; below either threshold no store builds, so the viable region is bounded on both axes.

findings.statement: As the external geochemical gradient declines over the run, replicator selection drives the population from externally-driven (pump fraction ~0) to internalized gradient generation (pump fraction ~0.95) while persisting — the bioenergetic internalization is an evolutionary outcome, not a scripted upgrade.

evidence.observed: internalization 0.00 -> 0.95; survivors 1.0 at the collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: BioenergeticSelectionProcess replicator dynamics over a (permeability × pump) strategy grid with a Sojo leaky-membrane fitness; the declining gradient flips the winning strategy from leaky-external to tight-pump.

findings.statement: A weak pump cannot internalize — when the external gradient collapses, the weak-pump lineage goes extinct (survivors → 0) while the efficient-pump lineage persists. Internalization is only viable with a sufficiently efficient pump (the Sojo leaky-membrane constraint).

evidence.observed: efficient survivors 1.0 vs weak-pump survivors 0.0 at collapsed gradient

findings.explanation: Below a pump-efficiency threshold the internal-pump flux cannot beat its cost against the lost external coupling, so no strategy clears the survival floor.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The survival region is a model output; the Sojo eta~=0.30 cost line is the external anchor it is compared against.
findings.statement: Survival off the collapsing gradient is a bounded REGION, not two representative runs: the native (pump catalyst efficiency × gradient floor) Decision map survives at 185/196 points (~94%), with the low-floor / low-efficiency corner going extinct. The Sojo cost line (η ≈ 0.30 — where internal pumping clears its maintenance cost plus the survival floor) marks the internalize-or-die boundary, and internalization (pump fraction > 0.5) fills the efficient interior where the lineage OWNS its energy rather than riding the residual external gradient.

evidence.observed: 185/196 (94%) survive over (catalyst_efficiency 0.05–1.3 × gradient_floor 0.005–0.35); Sojo cost line η≈0.30; internalization 0.009–0.949 across the grid; operating point (η=1.0, floor=0.02) deep inside

findings.explanation: The bioenergetic_survival_map sweeps the real replicator loop under the declining gradient and reduces each point to the surviving fraction + the survives PASS mask; the Sojo efficiency floor is read from the selection process config ((survival_threshold + c_pump + c_base)/k_int). Rendered as the survival landscape + internalization map (Decision view).
findings.next_action: Sweep decline_rate / alternative collapse scenarios to test how the survival region deforms with the speed of gradient loss (og-05b).

findings.statement: Accounting the free energy by SOURCE (not just the net flux) shows the useful disequilibrium shifting from the external geochemical gradient to internally maintained power as the environment declines — the external share of the useful free energy peaks near ~82% early in the run, then collapses to ~1% as the gradient falls while the population persists. The organism comes to "own" its energy: the geochemical gradient becomes a resource it taps, not the scaffold that organizes it.

evidence.observed: external share of useful free energy peaks ~82% then falls to ~1% as external pmf 0.40 → 0.02 V; survivors 1.0, internalization → 0.95

findings.explanation: The selection process emits the population-mean provenance breakdown (external tap k_ext·pmf·P vs internal pump k_int·pump·eff·(1−P) vs maintenance cost); rendered as the stacked energy-provenance trajectory + the gradient-dependence curve (Mechanism view).

findings.statement: At the nominal membrane and gradient the thioester / acyl-phosphate store beats the passive baseline from coupling activity 0.10: its potential bond + RT ln(q/(1-q)) crosses the 30 kJ/mol load at q = 0.12 (29.6 kJ/mol) and work begins to flow; net power rises from the passive 1.95e-17 W to a maximum 2.17e-17 W at activity 0.8 (+2.1e-18 W, autonomy 0.24) and falls again at 1.0 as the machinery cost outgrows the pool-limited store. The class pays on 54 % of the whole grid and up to P_H 3.2e-6 m/s.

evidence.observed: a* = 0.10; autonomy 0.027 at a*, 0.262 at a = 1; best +2.1e-18 W at 0.8; ceiling 3.2e-6 m/s

findings.explanation: Charging at a x 1e-21 mol/s against hydrolysis 1e-4/s + carrier permeation 1e-4 x P_H x A/V (6e-4/s at 1e-6 m/s) sets q(a); the draw gate opens once mu(q) >= 30 kJ/mol, i.e. q >= 0.13 for a 35 kJ/mol bond. Artifact: artifacts/internalization_threshold_report.json (per_class.thioester_acyl_phosphate.nominal).

findings.statement: The pumped H+/Na+ gradient store never pays at fatty-acid-like leak: at P_H 1e-6 m/s its potential reaches only 6.5 kJ/mol at full activity (q = 0.11; the Na+ leak at 1e-3 x P_H x A/V = 6e-3/s outruns the pump), so it draws no work and costs 5e-18 W of maintenance (net 1.45e-17 vs passive 1.95e-17 W). At P_H 1e-8 m/s it pays from activity 0.5 with autonomy 0.97 — the Sojo-2014 tradeoff inside one individual: the same leak that feeds the external tap drains the ion store, so owning a gradient needs a membrane tight to Na+.

evidence.observed: pays on 4 % of the grid; ceiling P_H 1e-8 m/s; potential 6.5 kJ/mol at nominal, autonomy 0.97 at 1e-8

findings.explanation: The ion store's leak is the only leak law tied to the membrane permeability (ratio x P_H); the chemical carriers leak by hydrolysis independent of the membrane and by a 10-100x smaller permeation, so only the ion class has a permeability ceiling two decades below the others.

findings.statement: A polyphosphate store (20 kJ/mol per bond, 100x slower hydrolysis than the thioester) never beats the passive baseline on the grid: clearing a 30 kJ/mol load needs RT ln(q/(1-q)) >= 10 kJ/mol, i.e. q > 0.98, and the drive turnover against carrier permeation charges it only to q = 0.69 (22 kJ/mol) at full activity. Kinetic stability does not substitute for bond energy once the load is fixed.

evidence.observed: pays on 0 % of the grid; potential 22.1 kJ/mol at q = 0.69 (a = 1, nominal); autonomy 0 everywhere at nominal

findings.explanation: The phosphorylation-potential logic of Buckel & Thauer made per-individual; the class would pay against a lower load (expert question).

findings.statement: The reduced-metal store charged by the Fe(II)-disproportionation drive sits at the load: its potential is pinned at 29.3-29.9 kJ/mol (q 0.62-0.67) once the draw gate half-opens, so it pays only from activity 0.8 (+1.8e-19 W, autonomy 0.17 at a*, 0.21 at full activity) and on 18 % of the grid, with a ceiling at the nominal P_H 1e-6 m/s.

evidence.observed: a* = 0.80; autonomy 0.17 at a*; best +1.8e-19 W at 1.0; pays on 18 % of the grid

findings.explanation: With a 28 kJ/mol effective transfer the store must be two-thirds charged to clear the load; the result depends directly on the hypothetical bond and drive numbers the package flags.

findings.statement: With the external gradient collapsed to the og-05 floor (0.02 V) the passive baseline keeps 1.7e-18 W; the thioester (3.7e-18 W, autonomy 0.79) and Fe-redox (1.9e-18 W, autonomy 0.74) individuals keep a larger positive budget drawn mostly from their store, while the ion-gradient and polyphosphate individuals go negative (-3.3e-18 W). The per-individual autonomy published by og-05's selection loop from the same power terms is 0.99 at its collapsed gradient (its population-mean pump fraction: 0.95).

evidence.observed: collapsed gradient, a = 1, P_H 1e-6: thioester net 3.7e-18 W / autonomy 0.79; fe_redox 1.9e-18 / 0.74; h_na and polyphosphate -3.3e-18 / 0

findings.explanation: Autonomy = internal / (internal + external) is the same readout for one individual here and for og-05's population; the switch of og-05's gates to it is recorded as a decision.

findings.statement: Numerical verification: on all 990 runs the cumulative identity in + E0 - work - dissipated = E(t) holds to 1.3e-14 relative, the second-law margin never goes below rounding (-1e-26 J against ~1e-13 J of intake), the per-tick dissipation is never negative and the capture efficiency never exceeds 0.30 (the passive tap's conversion; the internal classes capture less of their gross intake). The vg-data package energy_currencies carries 0 measured, 1 calibrated, 8 inferred, 3 extrapolated and 12 hypothetical parameters with no unsourced non-hypothetical entry.

evidence.observed: residual max 1.3e-14; margin min -1e-26 J; dissipation min 0; efficiency max 0.30; audit 0/1/8/3/12

findings.explanation: The store's free energy is an exact function of its charge (ideal mixing relative to the resting charge; capacitor for the ion gradient), so every tick's flows are differences of that function and the ledger closes by construction — the inequality is then a real check on the sign of each flow.

findings.statement: The thioester carrier pays on DIP-PERSISTENCE, not total throughput. Under a declining geochemical drive with the free-energy ledger closing (max |budget_residual| ~9e-19, no hidden inflow), the carrier does useful work through the dip (0.030) where the matched gradient-only control starves (0.006); but total useful work is NOT improved (carrier 0.256 vs gradient-only 0.282) - the carrier time-shifts banked energy into the dip and loses some to hydrolysis, and gates activation at the bond so it does not capture the above-bond surplus (true even at zero hydrolysis). So the carrier buys gradient-dip resilience, not raw throughput - the same persistence-not-throughput motif as Gate B (pore) and Gate C (membrane). Verdict qualified. Guardrail: the carrier funds endergonic work for the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis.

provenance.basis: study canonical run — the acceptance gate passed and was evaluated against this run; its per-gate value is not surfaced in the run outcomes summary, so provenance is recorded at study-run granularity.

findings.statement: The full free-energy ledger (activation / use / hydrolysis / stored) closes to machine precision in both arms (max |budget_residual| ~9e-19), so the dip-persistence benefit is real accounting, not an unbalanced source - there is no hidden energy inflow. A ledger that only closed with a hidden inflow would be a reported failure, not a pass.

provenance.basis: study canonical run — the acceptance gate passed and was evaluated against this run; its per-gate value is not surfaced in the run outcomes summary, so provenance is recorded at study-run granularity.

findings.statement: Carrier chemistry is one specified thioester cycle (Option B, tied to the og-12 rebuild); the total-work cost/benefit is a k_hydrolyze window - here the carrier does not beat gradient-only on total at any tested leak rate (including zero), so the benefit is strictly dip-persistence. The alternative carrier (acyl-phosphate) and a microkinetic enzyme-free resolution are the gold-standard follow-on (og-35a) that would re-test the energy benefit under resolved, multi-carrier chemistry rather than one lumped cycle.

provenance.basis: study canonical run — the acceptance gate passed and was evaluated against this run; its per-gate value is not surfaced in the run outcomes summary, so provenance is recorded at study-run granularity.

studies.claim: Across fidelities, a protocell's energetics buy robustness/persistence, not raw throughput. A primitive carrier captures geochemical free energy into a transferable store with a closing ledger (proto-energetics arm, supported); a compartment internalizes electrochemical work under selection and pays for it within a Sojo-bounded survival region (internalization arm, supported); which coupling chemistry pays is structure-sensitive and membrane-leak-dependent (5-class alt arm, supported, classes agree ~46%); and a specified thioester carrier does useful work through a gradient dip where gradient-only starves but does NOT improve total useful work (sharpened Gate-E arm, og-35, qualified). The consolidated headline is bounded by that sharpest arm: qualified, dip-persistence not throughput. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved.

derived.insight: An exergonic geochemical drive coupled to a pre-ATP thioester-class carrier builds and MAINTAINS a transferable energy currency under continuous endergonic load — the charged pool fills from empty and settles at ~39% of capacity, a spendable store held against discharge and hydrolysis. This is energetic bookkeeping (a carrier charged and spent), not a favourable reaction direction.

studies.name: og-heredity
studies.title: Chemical Inheritance: Can a Chemical Difference Be Transmitted?
studies.question: Can a protocell transmit a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost, without presuming a long high-fidelity RNA template?

findings.evidence_basis_note: Retention and fitness are model outputs; the one measured input (R18 ribozyme 96.7% per-site fidelity) is a parameter tracked in the inheritance_budgets provenance audit, not this readout.
findings.statement: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

evidence.observed: RNA-like fitness 0.38 (retention 0.62) vs non-heritable ~0

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner quasispecies ODE; above the Eigen error threshold correct templates outreplicate the mutational error tail (Eigen 1971).

findings.statement: Heredity modules rank by an evidence-based head-to-head — RNA-like (0.38) beats the cheaper, lower-fidelity peptide module (0.24), and both beat non-inheritance — while a module below the error threshold (per-site 0.90 × 30-mer, Q=0.04) suffers the error catastrophe (retention 0, fitness −0.10).

evidence.observed: RNA-like 0.38 > peptide 0.24; low-fidelity retention 0, fitness -0.10

findings.explanation: Whole-sequence fidelity Q = per_site_fidelity^length sets the threshold; longer high-fidelity polymers retain more information but cost more to replicate.

findings.statement: An agent-based LINEAGE model (individuals inherit a chemical phenotype at fission into a real tree) reproduces the Eigen error threshold (the imposed Q=fidelity^length relation) as a functional-persistence boundary in (per-site fidelity × length) space — AND shows that heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity template — compositional (GARD) and template-focused hybrid heredity persist at functional-persistence ~0.88 (seed-robust — 0.878±0.005 across the 5 graded seeds, 8/8 in a wider sweep) INDEPENDENT of length, where a long low-fidelity template collapses; the non-heritable control loses the parent↔offspring correlation (realized heritability ~0.04–0.11 vs 0.92–0.99 for the heritable modules) and crashes to ~5 individuals.

evidence.observed: compositional persistence 0.878±0.005 across 5 graded seeds (heritability 0.92), hybrid ~0.88 (0.92) — length-independent; template needs Q=fidelity^length above threshold; non-heritable heritability ~0.04–0.11, collapses every seed

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained agent-based reproduction with explicit fidelity/cost/competition. Template inheritance ratchets (Eigen 1971, no back-mutation) so a long low-fidelity template loses information; compositional inheritance drifts by multinomial fission of an autocatalytic composition (GARD, Segré 2000) — length-independent, so it escapes the length catastrophe. The realized heritability (offspring↔parent φ slope) separates true inheritance from the non-heritable control.

findings.statement: With heredity attached, parent and offspring phenotypes share information in every class — rna_like 1.46 +/- 0.10 bit, mineral_state 2.24 +/- 0.14, network 0.53 +/- 0.06, hybrid 0.49 +/- 0.03, compositional 0.47 +/- 0.03, peptide 0.14 +/- 0.22 (6 seeds; MI net of the permutation null, phenotype resolution 0.05) with realised heritability 0.45-1.0 — while every unattached control, whose daughters re-form their heritable material de novo from the same pool at the same price, transmits 0.00 bit with heritability < 0.01. Four classes (rna_like, network, compositional, hybrid) pass the strict pre-registered rule (MI converged on every seed, >= 0.1 bit, >= 0.05 bit above control); peptide fails because at q_p = 0.7 its whole-copy fidelity 0.06 sits below the Eigen floor 1/sigma = 0.33 and its function is lost before the estimator can converge; mineral_state fails convergence on one seed (bootstrap SE 0.15 bit) because its function decays as layer-copy errors accumulate at the nominal budget.

evidence.observed: 4/6 classes pass; controls 0.00 bit in every class; rna_like 1.46 bit, h2 0.93

findings.explanation: The information is measured on the phenotype (the function the heritable state confers), binned at a 5 % resolution so variation selection cannot see is not counted, bias-corrected (Miller-Madow) and reported net of a 20-permutation null; the convergence check is a time-ordered prefix ladder plus a bootstrap SE. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (classes.*.attached / .control).

findings.statement: Bits per joule span 3.8 decades across the six classes: mineral_state 5.4e19 (0 quanta, 0.1 quanta-equivalent per growth unit), network 1.3e18 (1 amino acid + 1 quantum per molecule), compositional 4.3e17 (1 amphiphile, 0 quanta), rna_like 4.9e16 (30 nucleotides + 30 quanta per copy), hybrid 2.5e16, peptide 9.0e15. Per offspring, rna_like spends 3.0e-17 J and 150 precursor molecules for 1.46 bit; network 4.2e-19 J and 4 molecules for 0.53 bit. Among classes whose estimate converged on every seed the Pareto front of (bits up, energy down) is {network, rna_like}; mineral_state (2.24 bit at 4.1e-20 J) would dominate both axes if certified.

evidence.observed: span 3.8 decades in bits/J; Pareto {network, rna_like}; cheapest and richest = mineral_state (uncertified)

findings.explanation: Costs are integer molecule and quantum counts drawn from the shared budgets by every copy event and converted with the package's 30 kJ/mol quantum and precursor energy equivalents (hypothetical); the InformationLedgerProcess integrates them against births and audits the store exactly (residual <= 3.1e-14 on 252 runs). Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (frontier, ledger).

findings.statement: og-06's "heredity need not presume RNA" survives as a class-substitution result, but only in one currency: among certified classes the best non-RNA class (network) carries 0.36x the RNA-like bits per offspring and 26x its bits per joule; compositional carries 0.32x and 9x. Templated heredity takes over from the organic attractor classes exactly where the Eigen floor admits it — rna_like at q >= 0.967 (Q = q^30 = 0.37 > 1/sigma = 0.33) carries 1.45 bit against their 0.5; at q <= 0.95 it is not attached and transmits nothing. The template never overtakes the mineral class within the swept range.

evidence.observed: nonrna bits/J fraction 26 (network); nonrna bits fraction 0.36; rna_like overtakes organic classes from q = 0.967

findings.explanation: og-06 graded persistence of function; this study grades transmitted bits against their price, so the two halves of og-06's claim separate: the template is the richest organic carrier, the attractors are the cheapest. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (gates.nonrna_bits_fraction, gates.nonrna_bits_per_joule_fraction, fidelity_transition).

findings.statement: With the HeredityAttachmentStep deciding, compositional, network and mineral heredity attach from 3 % of the nominal matched budget (every feed and the power scaled together), hybrid from 30 %, rna_like only at the full budget (precursor ratio 0.74 even then, latched at the first full tick) and peptide at none (fidelity ratio 0.17): mean attached-fraction span low-to-high budget 1.0 over the five attachable classes. The step's budget thresholds (10 copies per individual, energy margin 1) are hypothetical and swept; its fidelity floor is Eigen's Q >= 1/sigma. Two budget-driven reversals appear in the map: the mineral class's function collapses as the budget rises (more layers grown per generation means more copy errors: 0.93 at 3 % to 0.15 at 100 %) and the network class's information vanishes at 3x (every core saturates its niche, so there is no variation to transmit).

evidence.observed: attachment span 1.0; attach-from budgets 0.03 / 0.03 / 0.03 / 0.3 / 1.0 / never

findings.explanation: FMP 2.5 attachment as a lineage-level flag: before it, daughters re-form heritable material de novo and pay for it; after it, copies are partitioned at fission. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (attachment_map).

findings.evidence_basis_note: Reproduces the Eigen error threshold at the agent level - an independent theoretical prediction, not a fit.
findings.statement: The fidelity transition reproduces the error threshold at the agent level with exact stochastic dynamics: rna_like keeps function only from q = 0.967 (settled mean function 0.22; 0.55 at q = 0.99) and is refused and non-functional at q <= 0.95; peptide needs q_p >= 0.90 over 8 sites; the 8-site hybrid template attaches from q = 0.90; the mineral pattern from p_m <= 0.005 per bit per layer (function 0.10 there, 0.71 at 0.001). The attachment step's analytic floor and the simulated loss of function agree at every swept point.

evidence.observed: rna_like attaches from q = 0.967; peptide from 0.90; hybrid from 0.90; mineral from p_m = 0.005

findings.explanation: Each template's own copy rate rises with its function (the master sequence copies sigma-fold faster), daughters inherit a random half of the parent's molecules, and bulk growth carries the cell-level selection; the common sigmoid landscape makes a 1-2-error neighbour functional and the tail not. Artifact: artifacts/information_frontier.json (fidelity_transition).

findings.statement: The vg-data package inheritance_budgets carries 39 parameters: 1 measured (the R18 polymerase ribozyme's 96.7 % per-site fidelity), 6 inferred, 8 extrapolated and 24 hypothetical, none unsourced; the mineral class's defect-copy error — the number that makes it dominate the frontier — is hypothetical with no measured anchor, and the attachment thresholds are hypothetical and swept.

evidence.observed: audit counts measured 1 / calibrated 0 / inferred 6 / extrapolated 8 / hypothetical 24; unsourced []

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the frontier's headline ordering rests on the hypothetical precursor energy equivalents and the mineral copy error, which is why it is reported as a frontier under stated costs, not a ranking.

studies.claim: A protocell transmits a heritable chemical difference to its daughters at a feasible cost, and heredity need not presume a long high-fidelity RNA template: competing modules graded head-to-head show inheritance beats a non-heritable control and compositional/hybrid heredity escapes the Eigen length catastrophe (og-06), and an information-per-cost frontier ranks six mechanisms by heritable bits per joule with attachment conditional on budget (og-06-alt). Supported. Selectability is tested separately in og-evolvability.

derived.insight: A high-fidelity heredity module (RNA-like, 30-mer, per-site fidelity 0.99 → whole-sequence Q=0.74) retains functional information (C/(C+E)=0.62) and achieves net-positive lineage fitness (0.38) after its replication cost, outscoring the non-heritable control whose function degrades away.

studies.name: og-vent-specificity
studies.title: Vent Specificity: Are the Gates Vent-Specific or Generic?
studies.question: Do the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would any generic non-equilibrium drive pass them?

findings.evidence_basis_note: The generic non-equilibrium control fails all five vent-specific gates - a model outcome demonstrating specificity.
findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 (generic) vs the vent clearing the ≥10⁶-fold gate (a reduced-model magnitude, solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13; see og-03) — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the headline claims would be hollow if a feature-ablated control cleared the same bars. It does not.

findings.statement: Building the control exposed a latent control-integrity bug — catalyst_active=0 was silently swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default, so the no-catalyst control (here and in og-01's cross-run gate) secretly ran with full catalyst. Clamping to 1e-6 honors the control; og-01's gates still pass (9/9 + both cross-run) with the now-truthful control.

evidence.observed: no-catalyst formate dropped from ~0.014 mM (catalyst silently on) to ~2e-8 mM (honored); og-01 still PASS

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

studies.claim: A generic drive stripped of ALL THREE vent features at once (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst, no pore concentration) fails all five discriminating gates on the same real og-01/02/03 composites while the vent passes each — so the campaign's gates are NOT merely generic non-equilibrium detectors; the generic-nonequilibrium null is refuted by every gate (og-adv, canonical; verdict=refuted = null correctly rejected, gate_status=passed = the control discriminates). This is a LUMPED, all-feature-ablated contrast: it does not attribute the rejection to any single feature, and full vent-specificity — against competing realistic alternative environments — is NOT yet demonstrated (the H2 × Fe/Ni/S × pore-gradient 3-way factorial and the competing-environments study are planned, not run). Consolidated: specificity is demonstrated against a feature-ablated null, not yet against competing origin environments. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.

derived.insight: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 (generic) vs the vent clearing the ≥10⁶-fold gate (a reduced-model magnitude, solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13; see og-03) — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

studies.name: og-nutrient-bottlenecks
studies.title: Nutrient Bottlenecks: Are Nitrogen and Phosphorus Available with Carbon?
studies.question: Do the two non-carbon nutrient bottlenecks clear at the vent — does reduced nitrogen (ammonium) keep pace with carbon fixation, and does reactive phosphorus co-concentrate with carbon rather than precipitate — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?

findings.statement: FeS-mediated reduction of nitrate through nitrite sustains a standing ammonium pool (~1.0 mM) with an H2 reductant at ~80 C, the first reduced nitrogen the chemistry needs.

evidence.observed: settled NH4+ ~1.0 mM; peak production ~4.2e-5 mol/s

findings.explanation: A real ReducedNitrogenProductionProcess reduces NO3- -> NO2- -> NH4+ gated by H2 availability, an FeS temperature window and catalyst activity.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The settled C:N ~5.0 is a model output; the viable band 1-8 is the external anchor it is judged against.
findings.statement: At the favourable operating point reduced-N production keeps pace with the carbon-fixation demand — the C:N supply ratio settles at ~5.0, within the viable (near-Redfield) band.

evidence.observed: settled C:N supply ratio ~5.0 (viable band 1-8)

findings.explanation: The C:N supply ratio = carbon demand / reduced-N production; reductive amination draws ammonium into amino-acid precursors at a rate set by the carbon demand.

findings.statement: Ammonium is present only with BOTH an active FeS catalyst and an H2 reductant — it collapses to <1 µM when either is removed (each is necessary, not merely correlated).

evidence.observed: favourable NH4+ ~1.0 mM; no-FeS and no-H2 controls <1 µM

findings.statement: A parameter sweep over (nitrate supply x FeS activity) maps where reduced N keeps pace with carbon versus where nitrogen becomes limiting FIRST. Reduced N keeps pace only where the nitrate feed is sufficient AND the mineral is active; starving the feed drives the settled C:N supply ratio from ~5 to ~47 (nitrogen limiting), so the decision is a bounded region, not a representative run.

evidence.observed: favourable C:N ~5.0 (keeps pace) vs scarce-nitrate C:N ~47 (limiting); keeps-pace boundary at C:N = 8

findings.explanation: 16x16 sweep of the real open-flow reduced-nitrogen reactor (nitrate supply 2e-6-1e-4 M/s x FeS activity 0.05-1.0) reduced to the settled C:N supply ratio + a keeps-pace mask, rendered as the nitrogen phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_nitrogen_grid.py.

findings.statement: Nitrogen mass is conserved by construction — every internal reaction conserves N atoms, so the per-step accounting residual stays at ~1e-20 M (the matter-accounting invariant).

evidence.observed: max |n_mass_residual| ~1e-20 M over the run

findings.evidence_basis_note: Net reactive-P availability is a model output vs the open-pore no-enrichment control.
findings.statement: In the favorable thermal-gradient pore, reactive-P formation outpaces precipitation/adsorption loss — net reactive-P availability settles positive (~+1.8e-6 mol/s), reactive P accumulating to ~94% of the supplied phosphorus while only ~6% precipitates.

evidence.observed: ~+1.8e-6 mol/s net availability; reactive P ~94% of supply; ~6% precipitated

findings.explanation: Real libRoadRunner ODE P-speciation network: enrichment enters condensation as enr^2 and activation as enr, while precipitation is first-order in phosphate, so a concentrated pore tips phosphate's fate toward the reactive route.

findings.statement: The same real og-03 thermophoretic pore that lifts a dilute carbon feed across the ignition threshold (species-agnostic Soret + convection trap) co-concentrates phosphate: at the pore's enrichment the P reactive-availability is positive and the enrichment exceeds the carbon co-concentration floor (~10×). C and P co-concentrate in one pore regime — reported as an overlap boundary, not a fitted target.

evidence.observed: og-03 pore enrichment >> 10× carbon co-concentration floor; P reactive-availability positive at that enrichment

findings.explanation: The thermophoretic trap enrichment depends on the Soret coefficient and pore geometry, not on the solute identity, so the pore that concentrates carbon concentrates phosphate; coupling it to the P-speciation network shows reactive P becomes available in the same regime.

findings.statement: The feature ablation is decisive — an open pore / no thermal gradient (enrichment = 1) collapses reactive-P availability: net availability goes negative and ~96% of phosphorus precipitates to the mineral sink. Phosphate precipitates/adsorbs before it is chemically useful unless the pore concentrates it first.

evidence.observed: favorable net ~+1.8e-6 (6% precipitated) vs open-pore net < 0 (~96% precipitated)

findings.explanation: Without enrichment the condensation/activation fluxes (enr-gated) fall below the first-order precipitation loss, so phosphate drains into mineral-bound P — the phosphorus bottleneck made explicit.

findings.statement: A 16×16 sweep over (phosphate source × pore/thermal enrichment) maps where reactive P is available, not just that it is at one point. Reactive-P availability is bounded by the net-availability threshold (production = loss) on the enrichment axis; the PASS region is where that threshold is crossed AND the enrichment co-concentrates carbon (right of the ~10× carbon floor). Below the threshold phosphate precipitates before it is useful.

evidence.observed: reactive-P pool ranges ~0 to ~1 mM across the (source × enrichment) plane (~94% of supply, ~94 µM, at the favorable 1e-4 M point); availability bounded by net=0 and the carbon co-concentration floor

findings.explanation: 16×16 sweep of the real libRoadRunner composite reduced to the settled reactive-P pool, net availability and precipitated fraction; rendered as the reactive-P availability phase map (Decision view). Runner sims/compute_phosphorus_availability_grid.py.

studies.claim: Each non-carbon nutrient bottleneck clears individually: ammonium is produced and sustained, keeping pace with carbon fixation (a viable C:N) while the feature-ablation null produces none and nitrogen mass is conserved (nitrogen arm, supported); reactive phosphorus is available and co-concentrates with carbon in the pore while an open-pore no-enrichment control shows none and P mass is conserved (phosphorus arm, supported). Qualified overall: these are separate concentration successes, not a joint C/N/P feasibility — whether C, N and P are available together in compatible chemical forms and the same physical regime is the harder, open bar carried by og-precursor-pool and og-operating-window. Every matched null and arm verdict preserved.

derived.insight: FeS-mediated reduction of nitrate through nitrite sustains a standing ammonium pool (~1.0 mM) with an H2 reductant at ~80 C, the first reduced nitrogen the chemistry needs.

studies.name: og-autocatalysis-a2
studies.title: Endogenous Autocatalysis: Does a Self-Amplifying Cycle Form?
studies.question: Can vent-fed chemistry spontaneously form a balanced, self-amplifying autocatalytic cycle that beats a matched null with equal input fluxes — across the two representable routes (rule-generated linear-C6 formose chemistry, and the curated branched reductive-TCA cycle) — or does it only fix carbon (persistence, A1) without self-amplifying (A2)?

findings.statement: Study 29 receives the full 27→29 bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst state and time-dependent feeds — as typed inputs, verified complete before any network is assembled.
Study 29 receives the full 28→29 bundle — canonical species, balanced stoichiometry, rate forms, parameter bounds and confidence tags — as the reaction set, verified complete.

Stoichiometric detection plus kinetic simulation either exhibit a balanced, mass-conserving autocatalytic cycle with measurable amplification and net carbon fixation, or they do not; the finding reports which, with the amplification factor and net fixation when positive.

Any detected amplification must exceed a matched null (identical chemical input fluxes, autocatalytic topology removed); amplification not separable from the null is reported as feed-driven accumulation, not autocatalysis. This is the Gate A null arm.
The study reports the critical dilution rate above which any self-maintaining cycle collapses — its robustness envelope, not a single operating point.
Carbon, mass and charge close across the kinetic run with the 27 feeds as the only carbon/energy source; no untracked input.

If no genuine autocatalysis is found, the study isolates and names the missing precursor or rate-limiting mechanism — a clean negative is an accepted result that scopes downstream work, not a failure to hide.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The rTCA washout under vent H2 is the model's own outcome across the x1-x50 sweep, not fit to a target.
findings.statement: Under vent H2 a seeded reductive-TCA cycle washes out across the x1-x50 sweep and does not self-amplify; the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate to alpha-ketoglutarate, +18 kJ/mol; acetyl to pyruvate, +31 kJ/mol) are uphill and too slow against washout, mirroring the real cycle's need for ferredoxin rather than H2.

The cycle is autocatalytic in topology - its net turn (1 oxaloacetate + 4 CO2 + 5 H2 -> 2 oxaloacetate + 3 H2O) doubles the carrier oxaloacetate with no explicit coefficient-2 doubling reaction - so a coefficient detector reads gain 0 by construction and only a coefficient-free functional discriminator can judge it. (Acetate is used as an acetyl-CoA surrogate; fumarate is lumped.)

findings.evidence_basis_note: Meets the self-amplification bar only in a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier - outside the modeled vent regime.
findings.statement: In a labelled permissive counterfactual that lowers the carboxylation barrier, the rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar on the coefficient-free discriminator and is topology-specific - a degree-preserving null does not switch on - so the vent-condition negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a limitation of the cycle's wiring. This counterfactual is explicitly beyond-vent and is not a vent claim.

With the formose result, this resolves Gate A's A2 (endogenous autocatalysis) for the branched route - self-amplification is refuted under vent conditions, mechanistically, for both representable routes - and records the topology-capable finding as the basis for a possible stronger-reductant / beyond-vent follow-up, outside current vent scope.

Connect-and-close test (Phase-2 discovery cycle): coupling the real FiPy thermophoretic trap's spatial concentration to the A2 test does NOT recast the refutation, unlike the sibling self-maintenance study. Concentrating the CO2/H2 feed raises net carbon flux ~200x for the favorable network AND its degree-matched null in lockstep (margin over the null stays ~0, slightly negative: -9e-8 at x50; autocatalytic_gain 0 throughout), so the formose route gains throughput without a self-amplifying cycle. For the branched rTCA route, even x50 enrichment + 10x residence leaves the seeded cycle washing out, because concentration's mass-action push (RT*ln(50) ~ 11 kJ/mol) is below the uphill reductive carboxylations (+18/+31 kJ/mol dG0). The A2 refutation is a property of topology and reductant thermodynamics, not dilution - spatial concentration, which closes the self-maintenance CAC threshold gap (in freshwater), cannot close a thermodynamic/topological barrier. Composite: viva_genesis.composites.autocatalysis_concentrated.

studies.claim: Both tested routes fail under modeled vent conditions — endogenous self-amplifying autocatalysis is refuted across both representable routes, each against its own matched null. This is a limitation of the modeled vent redox environment, NOT a universal impossibility (see the beyond-vent counterfactual below). The linear-C6 formose arm (og-29) is thermodynamically refuted and seed-independent: the canonical doubling step (r409, 2 glycolaldehyde <-> threose) runs toward condensation (dG0 -16.4 kJ/mol) at vent feeds, so the splitting direction carries no net flux (gain 0, motifs 0 across x1-x50) and production is feed-driven, not self-amplified. The branched reductive-TCA arm (og-rtca) is autocatalytic in TOPOLOGY (its net turn doubles oxaloacetate with no coefficient-2 reaction, so a coefficient detector reads 0 by construction and a coefficient-free functional discriminator is required), yet washes out under vent H2 because the closing reductive carboxylations (succinate->a-ketoglutarate +18, acetyl->pyruvate +31 kJ/mol) run uphill and too slow against washout — the same reason the biological cycle uses ferredoxin, not H2. In a LABELLED beyond-vent counterfactual (lower carboxylation barrier + lower dilution) the same rTCA topology meets the self-amplification bar and is topology-specific (the matched null stays off), so the vent negative is a redox-environment limitation, not a defect of the cycle's wiring. The counterfactual is explicitly not a vent claim. Headline verdict is bounded by the honest negative of both arms: refuted. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved.

derived.insight: Study 29 receives the full 27→29 bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst state and time-dependent feeds — as typed inputs, verified complete before any network is assembled.

studies.name: og-self-compartmentation
studies.title: Self-Compartmentation: Does Metabolism Build Its Own Boundary?
studies.question: How does a vent-born chemical system acquire a self-made boundary and become a self-maintaining protocell — do amphiphiles assemble a retaining-but-not-isolating boundary, does encapsulation pay against a matched equal-feed null, does the integrated compartment self-maintain and beat a matched ablation, and are real fatty-acid vesicles stable — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
methods: MD-informed membrane permeability (short Martini CG-MD structural proxy)
matched no-endogenous-membrane ablation (permeability open, equal feeds)

findings.evidence_basis_note: Mixed-amphiphile vesicle viability where a single fatty acid fails reproduces the experimental window at vent pH / seawater ionic strength.
findings.statement: Mixed single-chain amphiphiles form viable vesicles at alkaline vent pH and seawater ionic strength, where a single fatty acid does not — reproducing the Jordan-2019 broadening of the pH / salt / divalent stability window.

evidence.observed: mixed viable ~8000; single-fatty-acid viable 0 at 0.35 M salt

findings.explanation: ProtocellAssemblyProcess broadens the pH window + salt/divalent tolerance with the co-surfactant fraction (coarse-grained, Jordan-calibrated).

findings.statement: The viable compartments retain internal chemistry (retention 0.91) while staying permeable to the external gradient (access 1.0) — a non-empty individuality-without-isolation region (product ≈ 0.90), the key requirement for a protocell that does not cut itself off from geochemical energy.

evidence.observed: retention 0.91 × access 1.0 ≈ 0.90

findings.explanation: Selective permeability — low effective permeability to large/charged internal metabolites, higher to small external resources.

findings.statement: Sweeping permeability (via temperature) traces the compartment through three regimes on the retention-access plane — too closed (retains but starves; low T), a viable window (individuality + access, peak ret×acc ≈ 0.92 at ~310 K), and too open (leaks; high T) before the membrane destabilizes entirely. Orthogonally, the viable salt ceiling rises with co-surfactant fraction: the feasibility map marks a viable region (individuality > 0.1) at 63/256 points (~25%) — vesicles survive at seawater salt (0.35 M) and beyond only with enough co-surfactant — the Jordan mixed-amphiphile advantage as a bounded 2-D region, not a single point.

evidence.observed: retention 0.97→0 and access rising to 1.00 then falling to 0 across 285–360 K; feasibility viable (individ>0.1) at 63/256 points, viable salt ceiling rising with mix_fraction

findings.explanation: Temperature sweep → retention-access arc; (mix × ionic strength) sweep → salt-tolerance feasibility map; rendered as the retention-access Decision view.

findings.statement: The parameter sweep exposed that an exact mix_fraction=0.0 is swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default (0.4), which would silently turn the single-fatty-acid control into a mixed-amphiphile run. The composite now clamps 0.0 to a negligible 1e-6 and reads mix_fraction via a state input, so the control is honored. (The study runner had already dodged it with 0.001.)

findings.statement: Sustained net growth leading to division occupies a bounded band of (network throughput × membrane permeability) — about a quarter of the swept grid — flanked by starvation where the membrane is too permeable (the product leaks out so the osmotic pressure never builds and nothing grows) and by lysis where it is too impermeable (the product is trapped, the pressure spikes past the burst tension and the membrane ruptures). studies.title: Protocell Ecology: Does Community Function Precede the Cell?
studies.question: Is protocell-era chemistry ecological before it is cellular — does a cross-feeding community out-produce the best single lineage (margin causally cross-feeding), does community function precede cell completeness and vanish without exchange — each against its own matched null with input fluxes held equal?
methods: lightweight dependency-free Gillespie SSA (integer cell counts)
matched mean-field Euler ODE on identical propensities
ring cross-feeding community vs best-single-lineage control at equal feed

findings.evidence_basis_note: Cross-feeding community output at equal shared feed is an SSA model result, not fit.
findings.statement: At equal shared feed, the SSA cross-feeding community out-produces the BEST single lineage by ~1.9x (community 1522 vs best-single 812 cumulative births; margin 710, positive in 100% of 24 seeds), and the margin is CAUSALLY cross-feeding - a knockout at equal feed collapses it to 11 (~2% of the community margin). Coexistence is stabilised by depletable byproduct pools (negative frequency dependence), not assumed: deterministically all 4 lineages persist (n_alive 4), the knockout excludes down (n_alive 2). So an emergent community function exists and is cross-feeding-caused, not mere diversity.

findings.statement: The community function is productivity, NOT robustness. Under low-count demographic noise the community is ~2x more variable than the monoculture (CV 0.085 vs 0.037) and loses a lineage in ~12% of runs, and a system-size (Omega) sweep shows this divergence from the deterministic mean-field GROWING as counts fall (Omega 0.7: 31% extinction, 20% margin erosion; Omega >= 2: effectively deterministic); the mean-field misses the lineage loss entirely. So the ecology RAISES productivity but PAYS in robustness — the COUNTERPOINT to Gate B (pore), Gate C (membrane) and Gate E/35 (energy carrier), each of which bought persistence/robustness but NOT throughput. Across all four gates robustness is the consistently traded axis. A community that were both more robust and more productive would be a cleaner result; buying one by spending the other is the honest qualified verdict.

findings.evidence_basis_note: Connected-vs-isolated robustness gain across 8 seeds is a model outcome.
findings.statement: A connected metacommunity of 8 pore compartments, each carrying a sparse coarse-grained protometabolic capability vector (2 of 12 functions intrinsic), develops functional redundancy (robustness 0.667) through cross-feeding and horizontal transfer, well above the isolated counterfactual (0.500) run on the identical seeded assignment. Across an 8-seed sweep the connected arm (0.71±0.08) strictly beats the isolated arm (0.42±0.06) on every seed (min gain 0.17), so the redundancy is a product of connectivity, not of the capability assignment.

evidence.observed: connected robustness 0.71±0.08 vs isolated 0.42±0.06 across 8 seeds, 8/8 pass, min gain 0.17

findings.explanation: Coarse-grained deterministic metacommunity (reproduction, not wrapped ALife). Cross-feeding (a compartment expressing a capability its neighbour lacks supplies the byproduct) and horizontal transfer (the capability is copied from a donor) spread sparse intrinsic capabilities into redundant coverage across the ring; a capability held by >= 2 compartments survives a single-compartment loss. Acquired capability decays toward the intrinsic set, so it persists only while continuously supplied.

findings.statement: Robustness EMERGES only in a bounded corner of (cross-feeding exchange_rate x inter-compartment diversity). At low diversity the compartments are near-identical, so cross-feeding/HGT have nothing to share and robustness stays at the sparse intrinsic floor (~0.17-0.25 regardless of exchange); at low exchange a diverse-but-disconnected set holds a broad repertoire fragilely (each capability in one compartment, ~0.33-0.42); only where diversity >= ~0.4 AND exchange crosses ~0.2 does robustness climb to 0.58-0.83. The transition is a phase boundary, not a monotone response to either knob alone. The companion three-view Decision map over (exchange_rate x parasite_load) at the canonical diversity sharpens this — robustness clears the 0.5 emergence boundary only once exchange crosses ~0.2 AND parasite load stays low (0.667 at the parasite-free operating point), collapsing toward 0 as parasites drain their neighbours.

evidence.observed: robustness landscape over (exchange x diversity): emergence boundary at exchange~0.2, diversity~0.4; companion (exchange x parasite_load) Decision map clears 0.5 only in the well-connected, low-parasite corner; canonical operating point 0.667 (auto-graded gate 0.646)

findings.explanation: Cross-feeding scales as exchange_rate/connectivity and is deficit-driven (zero between identical compartments), so diversity is the raw material and exchange is the spreading mechanism; both are necessary. The sparse capability space (2 of 12 intrinsic per compartment) makes an isolated compartment functionally fragile, so redundancy must be BUILT by the metacommunity.

findings.statement: The metacommunity's collective capability repertoire overlaps the Weiss-2016 anaerobic H2/CO2/FeS LUCA core at 0.60 (canonical) and 0.70±0.14 across seeds. This is reported as a far-end BOUNDARY the emergent set approaches from below — a phylogenomic constraint on capabilities eventually acquired — and is explicitly NOT a fitting target; the model is never tuned toward it.

evidence.observed: collective LUCA-core overlap 0.60 canonical, 0.70±0.14 across 8 seeds (reported, not gated)

findings.explanation: The LUCA reconstruction (anaerobic, H2-dependent, CO2-fixing, FeS-rich; Weiss 2016, 355 protein families; Moody 2024, LUCA embedded in an ecosystem ~4.2 Ga) is a constraint on which capabilities the lineage eventually acquired, used as a boundary condition on the emergent repertoire rather than as evidence the first compartments were LUCA-like.

findings.statement: The community of a carboxylating and a hydrogenating lineage holds malate (c4_diacid_hydroxy) at 6.4e-9 M in its reducer agents although the fixer monoculture, the reducer monoculture and the private (no-sharing) arm hold 0 M and neither monoculture ever produces it; the generalist (complete-cell) arm holds 1.36e-7 M, so the community reaches 4.7 % of a complete cell (3.9e-3 vs 0.08 molecules per 1-fL agent: a mean-field occupancy). The best agent in the community holds 14 of the 15 product classes in the union (max completeness 0.933, mean 0.867), so the function is present while no cell is complete.

evidence.observed: 1 community-only class (c4_diacid_hydroxy); levels community 6.4e-9 / mono 0 / private 0 / generalist 1.4e-7 M; max completeness 0.933

The exchange rules fired 468,331 times on the canonical run (secretion 135,316, uptake 115,466, pore diffusion 93,009, feed / washout 124,540); no rule moves a capability.

evidence.observed: vanish without exchange 1/1; precursor oxaloacetate 1.1e-3 molecules/tick; firings 468,331

studies.name: og-independence
studies.title: Independence from the Vent: Can a Lineage Escape Its Cradle?
studies.question: How independent of its geological cradle can a vent-born protocell lineage become — what minimum innovation set lets it persist as external support is withdrawn, which supports can it internalize vs which remain hard dependencies, and is any apparent independence causally attributable to a specific innovation against a matched ablation with input fluxes held equal?
methods: coarse-grained co-limited free-energy budget (reused from og-08)
per-support one-at-a-time withdrawal (vs og-08's joint relaxation)

findings.evidence_basis_note: Off-gradient persistence of the full innovation set vs ablated subsets is a model outcome.
findings.statement: Under withdrawing geological support (external gradient, mineral access and feed all relaxed to zero), the full innovation set persists off-gradient (surviving fraction 1.0, net budget +0.36) while removing any single innovation collapses persistence to 0 in this joint all-at-once withdrawal — each component is individually necessary here, though the 2³ subset lattice (og-08-alt-robust) resolves the triple as advantageous but driver-specific, NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit (only pump+heredity interact; the importer is required by no driver; the hard dependency is the geological gradient).

evidence.observed: full set survivors 1.0; -pump 0.0, -importer 0.0, -heredity 0.0

findings.explanation: Deterministic co-limited (Liebig-minimum) free-energy + resource budget; as support -> 0 the external tap and ambient substrate both vanish, so persistence needs an internal pump (energy) AND an importer (resource) at once, held by heredity (information maintenance).

findings.statement: In the og-08 joint all-at-once withdrawal (rescoped) the set appears jointly necessary because the budget is co-limited — gross = min(energy, resource). A lone pump raises energy but the resource term still limits growth (and vice versa), so a half-equipped lineage pays an innovation's upkeep without a co-benefit; the survival frontier shows single knockouts needing MORE environmental support than even the bare control over part of the range.

evidence.observed: frontier: full persists to support 0; -pump 0.33, -heredity 0.44, none 0.48, -importer 0.59

findings.explanation: Liebig's law of the minimum — co-limitation means energy and resource cannot substitute for one another, so autonomy requires acquiring both independently of the vent (pump + importer) and holding that machinery (heredity).

findings.statement: Heredity is necessary not as an energy or resource term but as information maintenance — without it the adaptive machinery degrades over the run (machinery integrity 1.0 -> 0.007, an error-catastrophe decay), so the pump and importer cannot be held and the lineage collapses even though it carries them.

evidence.observed: -heredity: machinery integrity 0.007 at run end, survivors 0.0

findings.explanation: The heredity flag gates the per-step machinery decay; without it the innovation terms (pump, importer) scale toward zero as machinery is lost, so the budget falls below the survival floor.

findings.statement: Per-driver one-at-a-time withdrawal resolves the attribution confound the original all-at-once relaxation could not. Withdrawing each vent driver alone (the other two held at full) across 24 structures × 3 drivers × 8 innovation subsets: the vent-pmf GRADIENT is a hard dependency — the full innovation set rescues its withdrawal in only 4.2% of structures, and where it does the required set is {pump, heredity}; MINERAL access is freely survivable (0.958, no specific innovation required); FEED is borderline (0.75, no specific innovation required). The required set is therefore DRIVER-SPECIFIC, not a universal {pump, importer, heredity} triple — {pump, heredity} rescues the gradient, mineral and feed need no specific innovation, and the importer is never individually required. The lumped all-at-once run could not attribute because the gradient — rarely survivable, needing pump+heredity — dominated the joint collapse. confound_resolved; differential survivability; ledgers close at every point.

With every driver withdrawn to 1 % of the vent level, none of the eight subsets of {pump, importer, heredity} persists under any of the 24 sampled structures (0 persisting runs of 192); the best full-set lineages end s02 -3.8e-20 W, s21 -1e-19 W, s14 -1e-19 W short, their machinery lost as the cell's organic carbon falls to the floor and the heredity class's precursor pools with it.

evidence.observed: full set persists under 0 of 24 structures at the nominal floor; viable structures 0

findings.explanation: The persistence rule reads the settled work and material budgets with every driver at its floor. Off-gradient the external tap is gone, the store runs on the drive the cell's own H2 / organic pool sustains, and the upkeep (the energy-coupling maintenance at full coupling, 5.1e-18 W) takes most of what the best store delivers; a lineage whose heredity class cannot hold its machinery on a tenth of the carbon loses the pump with it. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice, floor_map).

findings.statement: At a 10 % ocean the only subset that persists is {pump, heredity}, under 2 of 24 structures (s16 (thioester acyl phosphate store, hybrid heredity, mixed boundary at the measured anchor, constant upkeep; net 9.5e-19 W, machinery 0.93, autonomy 1); s19 (thioester acyl phosphate store, rna like heredity, single chain boundary at the extrapolated anchor, constant upkeep; net 1.2e-18 W, machinery 0.97, autonomy 0.99)); the full set persists under 0. Over the viable structures the required intersection is {pump, heredity} and the importer is required in 0 of them: in the same structures the full set runs a deficit because the importer costs more than it returns (s16: net -4.9e-19 W with the importer on, its cost 1.7e-18 W; s19: net -1.1e-18 W with the importer on, its cost 1.9e-18 W).

evidence.observed: rich-floor lattice: pump+heredity 2/24, full set 0/24; required intersection [pump, heredity], union [pump, heredity]

findings.explanation: The ActiveUptakeRule concentrates organics to 30 % of the vent level against the membrane's leak at the thermodynamic cost RT ln(c_in/c_out) per mole over a 0.5 efficiency, spending up to 30 % of the work supply; with the drive already saturated by ocean H2 (K 10 uM) the imported organics add nothing to the budget, so the importer is a pure cost under the ecology-stage extrapolated leak. Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich, discrimination_rich).

findings.statement: The storage model reproduces the energy-store result inside the world — the H+/Na+ gradient store never charges at the fatty-acid leak and polyphosphate never clears its 30 kJ/mol load, while the four stores deliver at most 0 (polyphosphate), 0 (H+/Na+ gradient), 6.6e-18 (thioester) and 5e-18 W (Fe-redox) — and the inheritance class reproduces the heredity stage's budget sensitivity: settled machinery off-gradient at the rich floor is hybrid 0.77, mineral state 0.74, rna like 0.41, compositional 0.27, network 0, peptide 0; peptide and network hold none, the templated classes decay as the carbon falls, the mineral and compositional classes hold on a fraction of the budget.

evidence.observed: internal power by storage class and machinery by inheritance class over the full-set runs at the rich floor

findings.explanation: The structural axes do what the earlier studies found when their classes are composed: the autonomy question factors into "can the store run the lineage" (the energy-store question) and "can the inheritance class hold the machinery on what the cell makes off-gradient" (the heredity question). Artifact: artifacts/robust_innovation_set.json (lattice_rich.by_axis).

findings.statement: Off-gradient the lineages supply essentially all of their own work, material and catalysis — the persisting ones at work 1, material 0.99, information 0.89 (total 0.99); the full-set lineages at a mean total autonomy of 0.93 against 0.71 in the vent, where the tap supplies the work (work autonomy 0.054) — and most of them still cannot pay for themselves.

evidence.observed: autonomy (work / material / information / total) of persisting and of all full-set runs at the rich floor; in-vent values

findings.explanation: The continuous autonomy value is a share (internal / total); once the tap and the pore feed are withdrawn every surviving supply is internal, so autonomy saturates while the absolute budget can still be negative.
