findings.statement: All seven ledgers close on every one of the 485 runs (carbon 1.7e-10, N 1.4e-14, P 1.5e-14, free energy 4.4e-14, information store 1.1e-14, rewrite 4.9e-32, charge 4.7e-14, element 0); 40441 structural events were logged (22365 divisions, 724 extinctions); the og-adv generic control (every driver at its floor from t = 0, no pore concentration) persists under 0/24 structures. The vg-data package carries 32 parameters: 5 calibrated (the vent posterior), 4 inferred, 3 extrapolated, 20 hypothetical, none unsourced.

evidence.observed: ledger ok on 485/485 runs; generic persists 0/24; audit {measured: 0, calibrated: 5, inferred: 4, extrapolated: 3, hypothetical: 20}

findings.explanation: The honesty indicator; the verdict rests on the 20 hypothetical numbers.

findings.statement: One-at-a-time, each of the 3 support channels is internalizable with the full innovation set (gradient / mineral / feed survivors all 1.00, budget margins +0.26 above the floor — transparent, not knife-edge) and the matched 2³ subset lattice resolves the attribution driver-specifically: the triple is advantageous but NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit — only pump+heredity interact positively, the importer is required by no driver, mineral and feed need no innovation, and the hard dependency is the geological gradient (rescued by pump-internalization, which flips below pump efficiency ~0.7). og-08's all-at-once relaxation cannot make this attribution — it escapes only with the full set and fails if ANY innovation is removed — so the subset lattice and one-at-a-time rebuild resolve the confound. So the lineage achieves a graded, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing escape.

The gradient (pH/pmf drive) is the budget-sensitive support: its pump-internalization is affordable only for catalyst_efficiency >= ~0.7 and flips to a hard dependency below that (survivors 0 at efficiency <= 0.6, 1.0 at >= 0.7). This is grounded in study-35's persistence-not-throughput result — the internal carrier has limited surplus — so at a less efficient pump the vent's gradient drive is the hard dependency. Mineral and feed need no innovation (robust across the sweep; the importer is required by no driver). The result is reported as a located boundary, not a knife-edge pass.

Honest scope: the three channels are gradient (pH/pmf), mineral_access (mineral catalysis) and feed (H2+CO2+organics LUMPED), so the first cut does NOT resolve independence for H2 / CO2 / organics individually; and the innovations (pump/importer/heredity) are coarse budget abstractions from og-08, so the result is an affordability/attribution profile, NOT a demonstrated real-cell escape. The gold-standard follow-on og-37a resolves the feed per-feedstock, adds temperature as an Arrhenius rate modifier, and runs the combinatorial multi-withdrawal with resolved internalization chemistry.

studies.claim: A vent-born protocell lineage reaches GRADED, attributed independence, not an all-or-nothing (and not a free) escape. og-08 withdrew gradient + mineral + feed JOINTLY and found a coordinated innovation set {internal pump, importer, heredity} where any single removal collapses persistence — but joint relaxation cannot attribute which innovation rescues which support, so that general minimal-sufficiency reading is rescoped to a reduced, model-specific hypothesis (supported within its one coarse model). og-08-alt-robust then tests the set ACROSS model structures on a 2³ subset lattice and resolves it driver-specifically: the {pump, importer, heredity} triple is advantageous but NOT a jointly-necessary irreducible unit — only pump+heredity interact positively, the active importer is required by no driver (a net cost under a leaky membrane), and the hard dependency is the geological gradient (the full set rescues its withdrawal in only ~4.2% of structures), while mineral (0.958) and feed (0.75) are freely/borderline survivable needing no specific innovation. og-37's one-at-a-time withdrawal agrees: the gradient is the budget-sensitive hard dependency (pump-internalization flips below pump efficiency ~0.7, grounded in the energy arm's persistence-not-throughput surplus), while mineral and feed need no innovation. Because the feed is LUMPED (H2+CO2+organics) and the innovations are coarse budget abstractions, this is an affordability/attribution profile, not a demonstrated escape — headline verdict qualified. Every matched null and every arm verdict is preserved explicitly.

studies.name: og-evolvability
studies.title: Evolvability and Selection: Is an Inherited Difference Selectable?
studies.question: Does a daughter-inherited chemical difference produce a reproducible, selectable fitness difference, and does the population shift under selection rather than drift?
methods: fitness grounded in study-32/33 retention -> division-rate coupling
Wright-Fisher selection vs a matched no-inheritance null
vasas-2010 evolvability caveat tested, not assumed

findings.evidence_basis_note: The selectable-heredity signal over 8 seeds x 40 generations is the evolutionary model's outcome vs the vasas-2010 null.
findings.statement: There IS selectable chemical heredity (not the vasas-2010 null). Across 8 seeds x 40 generations at equal feeds, an inherited network-composition difference yields a reproducible parent-offspring fitness correlation (mean +0.949) far above the matched no-inheritance control (-0.018; permutation p=0.0001). Fitness is grounded in the real study-32/33 coupling (composition -> membrane retention -> standing pool -> division rate), so the correlation reflects a genuine mechanistic fitness consequence. Guardrail: selection acts on the inherited composition of the sustained A1 carbon-fixing network, not autocatalysis.

The inheriting population shifts composition measurably under selection (mean shift +0.551 toward higher-retention / longer-chain composition) while the matched no-inheritance control drifts (-0.004; permutation p=0.0002). Selection acts because both heritable variation and a reproducible fitness difference are present - the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat was tested (declared heritable variance sigma=0.03, not tuned) and the population shifts rather than drifts.

Heredity is carried by inherited NETWORK COMPOSITION (Option B, compositional / GARD-style), with the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat TESTED, not assumed - compositional inheritance carried enough selectable variance here for selection to act. Template copying (Option A, og-34a) is the higher-fidelity follow-on that would re-test selectable heredity under a copying mechanism, especially where compositional inheritance might prove too low-variance in other regimes.

studies.claim: A daughter-inherited chemical difference produces a reproducible, selectable fitness difference and the population shifts under selection rather than drifting: parent-offspring fitness correlation +0.949 vs a no-inheritance control, population shift +0.551 vs drift -0.004, against a matched no-inheritance null (og-34, canonical). studies.name: og-network-rescue
studies.title: Network Rescue: Does Pore Concentration Ignite the Reaction Network?
studies.question: Does pore concentration ignite the carbon-fixing reaction network where a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control does not?

findings.evidence_basis_note: Pore ignition at identical vent-posterior feeds vs the matched control is a model outcome.
findings.statement: At identical vent-posterior feeds (CO2/H2 = 1e-3), the concentrating pore ignites the network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4; connected; 17 persistent species) while the matched well-mixed nonconcentrating control does not (flux ~0; not connected) - spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux.

The C6 network - the one og-29 found ignites only at ~20x well-mixed feed - ignites directly in the demo pore at the vent-posterior base feed (porosity 0.88, pore-local 0.023 M), net carbon flux +4.49e-4, connected, 22 persistent species, while the matched well-mixed C6 control stays dead (flux +1.5e-9, not connected). C6 shows the same bounded-window behavior as C4 - a tight pore (porosity 0.70, pore-local 2.63 M) gives higher flux (+0.072) but the connectivity metric still degrades (network_connected = 0), so there is no flux-washout upper bound; the bound above is physically-implausible feeds plus connectivity-metric degradation, not flux loss.

A porosity sweep shows the pore's benefit is a bounded window, not a broad swath. Net carbon flux rises monotonically with confinement (no flux washout in the C4 network, even at extreme feeds), but the connectivity-defined ignition (og-29's network_connected metric) occupies a bounded, somewhat brittle porosity band (~0.80-0.90; pore-local ~0.01-0.2 M) - below it enrichment is sub-threshold, and above it the pore-local feeds become physically implausible (porosity 0.70 implies 2.6 M, 0.60 implies 36 M) while the connectivity metric itself degrades, flipping 1/0/1 across adjacent porosities at similar high flux. So ignition is met in a specific pore-geometry window, not robustly across geometry.

network_connected (og-29's ignition metric) is a BRITTLE proxy near threshold - at high feed the network stays carbon-fixing (flux high and monotone in enrichment) but loses broad connectivity (connected flips to 0), the same signal og-29 recorded as "washout" at x50 well-mixed, now seen to be connectivity-breadth loss rather than flux loss, consistent across C4/C6 and well-mixed/pore. This is a methodological caveat on the ignition metric only; it does NOT touch og-29's formose refutation, which rests on the thermodynamic mechanism and the coefficient-free seed-independence discriminator, not on connectivity.

og-30 both meets Gate B's own criterion (pore flux far exceeds the matched control) and resolves Gate A's open A1 feed-plausibility question: the ~20x well-mixed ignition gap is bridged by pore enrichment within the physical pore window, so a carbon-fixing network persists at vent-realistic feeds inside a pore (demonstrated on C4 and confirmed directly on C6).

studies.claim: At identical vent-posterior feeds held equal, a concentrating mineral pore ignites the carbon-fixing network (net carbon flux +4.5e-4, 17 persistent species; confirmed on the six-carbon network) while a matched well-mixed, nonconcentrating control stays dead — spatial concentration is the only difference, so the pore causes the productive flux (og-30, canonical). Supported.

studies.name: og-vent-interface
studies.title: The Mineral Interface: Does It Sustain Flux Within a DIC Window?
studies.question: Does the evolving mineral-water interface sustain its H2 / inorganic-carbon flux and pH/redox gradient as minerals evolve, and where does the DIC window bound it?

findings.evidence_basis_note: The sharp two-regime DIC cliff is a real-PHREEQC model finding.
findings.statement: The interface's supply↔throttle behavior is a sharp two-regime cliff, not a gradual depletion: across a dense fluid_dic sweep (2–20 mM) real PHREEQC carbonate saturation crosses SI=0 at ~3.2 mM, and the interface either SUPPLIES (undersaturated, SI<0: H2 flux 2.75e-4 → 3.55e-5 from 2.0 → 3.0 mM, no precipitation, pore open at porosity 0.96–0.97) OR THROTTLES-AND-CHOKES (supersaturated, SI≥+0.7: precipitation 0.23–0.29 and catalytic-accessibility drop ~0.12, but H2 flux crashes four orders to ~1e-8 and porosity collapses to 0) — never both. No fluid_dic sustains flux AND exercises throttling with the pore open (window_exists=False), so the self-limiting carbonate chemistry forces the vent operating point into the undersaturated regime. The free-energy/mass/charge ledger closes at every sweep point.

Over transport timescales the interface delivers H2 and inorganic-carbon fluxes and a maintained pH/redox gradient at or above the levels used by published vent-reactor and H2-dependent-metabolism work; the study reports the full time series and the onset of decay, not a single terminal value.

Precipitation and surface passivation reduce reactive surface and throttle catalytic supply on the mineral-evolution timescale — the interface is depleting, and the study quantifies the crossover time at which delivery drops below the downstream-required threshold.

The cross-interface electrical driving force is non-trivial and of the sign/scale needed to drive CO2 reduction, verified independently by a FEniCSx Nernst–Planck solve against the FiPy transport result.
Mass, charge and energy close across the coupled PHREEQC+FiPy+Reaktoro solve to tolerance with no untracked feeds.

The study emits the full 27→29 transfer bundle — H2 + inorganic-carbon flux, pH, T, ionic activities, catalyst (mineral-surface) state and time-dependent feeds — as the typed boundary condition study 29 consumes.

studies.question: Does the vent's reduced-carbon chemistry deliver a functional precursor pool (not just bulk organic flux) that the reaction-network and amphiphile studies can consume?

parent_studies.provides: the H2-driven CO2-reduction yield hierarchy and catalytic-interface rates the balanced reaction sets are anchored to

the joint non-carbon precursor feasibility - reduced-nitrogen (ammonium) availability keeping pace with carbon fixation at a viable C:N and reactive-phosphorus availability co-concentrating with carbon in the thermophoretic pore, each in compatible chemical forms under the pore / thermal-gradient physical regime

findings.statement: At the 2 mM DIC lower bound the C1 feedstock (formate) settles near 0.6 mM, the dominant precursor - the direct CO2-reduction product, consistent with og-carbon-fixation's formate-dominant hierarchy.

findings.statement: Carbon-source attribution shows the functional precursor pool is >=99% assembled de novo from the CO2 feed, not passed through from fed organics - the vent chemistry genuinely builds the pool.

evidence.observed: de-novo CO2-fixed fraction = 1.000

findings.explanation: A steady-state linear apportionment over the atom-mapped stoichiometry attributes every functional-precursor carbon to the CO2 feed, distinguishing a delivered pool from upstream carry-over.

findings.statement: The reaction sets are atom-balanced exactly (element residual 0) and both the carbon ledger and the degree-of-reduction electron budget close to integrator tolerance - the yield vectors rest on a conserved, thermodynamically consistent network.

findings.explanation: The pool is delivered de novo with closed budgets, but C-C condensation leaves the functional C2+ precursors far too dilute to be functional - the real concentration gap this study exposes.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The C2:C1 ceiling is extrapolated from the eQuilibrator component-contribution dG' at the package's single condition point; it is the thermodynamic bound, not a fitted or directly measured value.
findings.statement: The low C2+ hierarchy is a thermodynamic ceiling, not a tuning artifact: the aggregate C2:C1 ratio is invariant across a 1000x sweep of the C-C condensation rate constants (detailed balance pins it to dG'), and it saturates as washout -> 0 (transport is not the limit), rising only from ~3e-7 (2 mM DIC) to ~2e-6 (20 mM) - and the acetate:formate ratio sits at ~1.5e-8, 3-5 orders below Preiner's batch ~5e-4.

evidence.observed: acetate:formate ~1.5e-8 (FAIL vs 1e-4); aggregate C2:C1 3e-7->2e-6 across DIC, invariant to 1000x rate sweep, saturating in residence time

findings.explanation: Reversible kinetics with detailed balance (k_r = k_f exp(dG'/RT)) make the steady-state C2:C1 ratio a function of the eQuilibrator dG', independent of forward-rate magnitude; longer residence time only shifts it ~50x then plateaus. The condensation ceiling is thermodynamic.

findings.statement: All three ablation controls collapse the functional pool: no-H2 (reductant), no-catalyst (mineral+base sites) and no-gradient (no sustained vent resupply) each drive it to <1% of canonical - each is a necessary condition.

studies.claim: The vent's reduced-carbon chemistry delivers a de-novo, atom-balanced, budget-closed functional precursor pool whose controls all collapse it - but within the defensible DIC window the functional C2+ precursors are thermodynamically bounded to sub-micromolar, orders below what downstream chemistry can consume. Qualified.

studies.name: og-self-maintaining-individual
studies.title: Self-Maintaining Individuality: Does the Chemistry–Boundary Loop Close?
studies.question: Does the coupled chemistry-and-boundary system maintain itself - chemistry making the boundary that in turn sustains the chemistry - under perturbation, without a built-in production or retention gain?

parent_studies.provides: the functional amphiphile-precursor yield vectors from og-precursor-pool - the acetate the chemistry delivers to synthesis
the narrow S_T-conditional corner from og-operating-window where the precursor pool is consumable - this study's favorable premise
the real membrane machinery (ProtocellAssembly / chain-extension synthesis, permeability, retention)

findings.evidence_basis_note: The acetate the network delivers to synthesis is a model output of og-precursor-pool's real reactor (not fit); it is nonzero but far too dilute to build a membrane.
findings.statement: The chemistry->membrane arrow carries real signal: og-precursor-pool's network delivers acetate (C2) to the fatty-acid chain-extension (~1e-11 M canonical, ~1.4e-8 M enriched at og-operating-window's corner) - so the coupling exists; it is the concentration that fails.

evidence.observed: settled acetate ~1e-11 M (canonical); ~1.4e-8 M (operating-window corner, enriched+retained)

findings.explanation: Acetate is og-precursor-pool's C2 product; the chain-extension elongates it to long-chain fatty acids - the real chemistry->membrane path, present but thin.

findings.evidence_basis_note: aggregation_competent is a model output (long-chain pool / CAC), not fit to any target; it is the explicit no-built-in-gain witness, and it lands orders below 1.
findings.statement: The amphiphile pool the chemistry produces does not clear its CAC: aggregation_competent ~9e-8 at the canonical point and well below 1 even at og-operating-window's corner, so no membrane forms without assuming one. The long-chain fraction is fine (~0.95) - it is a pure concentration failure, the same nM gap cascading from the precursor pool.

evidence.observed: aggregation_competent ~9e-8 (canonical, FAIL vs 1); amphiphile pool ~1e-9 M vs CAC 5e-3 M

findings.explanation: A membrane forms only when the long-chain pool reaches its critical aggregation concentration; the chemistry's output is ~4-7 orders below the acetate needed for that, so the boundary cannot be built endogenously.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The closure result is a model prediction across the fixed point + ablations + the built-in-gain comparison; it is the central negative, not an assumed one.
findings.statement: Reciprocal self-maintenance does not close endogenously without a built-in gain, at the canonical point or og-operating-window's corner, and all three ablations also fail to close. With the built-in gain the loop "closes" only because retention is forced to the long-chain value regardless of CAC - a membrane is never physically present - which is exactly the false closure the no-built-in-gain constraint forbids.

evidence.observed: closes(no gain) = False at canonical and the operating-window corner; all 3 ablations fail; with-gain closure is assumed-only

findings.explanation: The membrane->chemistry arrow can only help once a membrane exists; since the chemistry never clears CAC, the gate stays open (retention 0), washout is unreduced, and the loop has no fixed point with a real boundary.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The cascading gap is extrapolated across the precursor-pool → operating-window → self-maintenance chain from each study's model outputs and the CAC-clearance threshold; it is the headline quantification, not a fitted value.
findings.statement: The precursor concentration gap cascades across the precursor-pool → operating-window → self-maintenance chain and is quantified: og-precursor-pool's acetate (9.6e-12 M) is ~6.9 orders below the CAC-clearance threshold (7.6e-5 M) at the canonical point; og-operating-window's best corner lifts the acetate the membrane sees to 6.7e-9 M, still ~4.1 orders short; neither closes the loop. The central chemistry-to-individual transition is open, bounded here by a ~4-order concentration shortfall even at the most favorable defensible corner.

evidence.observed: orders short of CAC ~6.9 (canonical), ~4.1 (operating-window corner); acetate needed for CAC clearance ~7.6e-5 M

findings.explanation: Each step narrows but does not close the gap: the thermodynamic ceiling (og-precursor-pool) -> narrow S_T-conditional enrichment (og-operating-window) -> still sub-CAC amphiphile synthesis (this study). The shortfall is the concrete, quantified open problem.

studies.claim: The coupled chemistry-and-boundary system does not maintain itself endogenously under defensible vent conditions: the chemistry's acetate (even at og-operating-window's favorable corner) yields an amphiphile pool ~4 orders below its CAC at the corner and ~7 orders below at the canonical point, so no membrane forms without assuming it, and reciprocal maintenance fails to close without a built-in retention gain - across all three ablations. A scoped refutation of endogenous closure; the broader individuality-emergence question stays open (§9).

derived.insight: The chemistry->membrane arrow carries real signal: og-precursor-pool's network delivers acetate (C2) to the fatty-acid chain-extension (~1e-11 M canonical, ~1.4e-8 M enriched at og-operating-window's corner) - so the coupling exists; it is the concentration that fails.

studies.name: og-self-maintaining-concentrated
studies.title: Self-Maintenance Under Pore Concentration: Does Thermophoresis Close the Loop?
studies.question: Does coupling the supported spatial-concentration mechanism (the vent pore's thermophoretic trap) to the refuted self-maintenance loop close the 4-7 order amphiphile/CAC gap - and at what pore geometry and amphiphile Soret coefficient?
methods: real FiPy Baaske thermophoretic trap (enrichment read from the solved column)

findings.statement: The control (no concentration) reproduces og-self-maintaining-individual exactly: base aggregation_competent 9.46e-8, matching the documented ~9e-8 canonical shortfall. The connected model inherits the refutation before adding the pore.

Coupling the real FiPy Baaske trap closes the loop at near-maximal trapping: S_T 0.10, dT 30 K, 5 mm column -> enrichment ~9.6e7 -> aggregation_competent_concentrated 8.98 (clears CAC). Closure boundary: S_T >= 0.07 with dT >= 45 K, or S_T >= 0.10 at dT 30 K.

At a conservative Soret (0.05) the loop does not close at any realistic dT up to 45 K (conc aggregation_competent ~0.09). The chemistry's base pool cannot be pushed above ~1.6e-5 by feed alone (precursor/degradation limited), so the minimum enrichment needed is ~6e4 even at the best feed.

The closing Soret regime is contested at vent conditions: surfactant/micelle Soret coefficients decrease strongly with ionic strength (Vigolo 2010; interacting-micelle Soret), and decanoate above its pKa is anionic, so a seawater pore likely suppresses S_T below the closing band. Premicellar aggregation of C8-C12 fatty acids (Kanicky 2003) raises effective size modestly but probably not to S_T 0.10. A thermal diffusion column has, however, concentrated lipid precursors above the critical vesicle concentration experimentally (Budin 2009), and heated gas-bubble interfaces concentrate lipids faster still (Matreux 2021) - a stronger mechanism to test next.

Follow-up model (#2): with an ionic-strength-dependent amphiphile Soret S_T(I) = S_T0 + A*lambda_D(I)^2 (charged-surfactant 1/I suppression; Debye length lambda_D = 0.304/sqrt(I) nm), closure is gated by SALINITY. Calibrated so a near- maximal self-associating amphiphile reaches S_T 0.10 at I=0.01 M: the loop closes in freshwater (I <= ~0.01-0.03 M; S_T 0.10-0.30; enrichment 1e12-1e19) but NOT at marine vent salinity (I >= 0.1 M; S_T ~0.011-0.019; enrichment ~24-190; 6 orders short). So the refutation STANDS for the primary marine alkaline-vent hypothesis, while a low- salinity terrestrial/freshwater-geothermal setting (cf. Mulkidjanian; the 2026 unfavorable-vent reassessment) is where the pore could close the loop. CAVEAT: the absolute salinity threshold is calibration-dependent (no measured decanoate S_T(I) was found); robust are the 1/I suppression direction and its strong tilt toward low salinity.

GROUNDING (follow-up): the S_T(I) relation was re-anchored to measured thermophoresis data - a small-ion floor S_T0 ~2e-3 K-1 (NaCl/KCl; Di Lecce and Bresme PCCP 2025), a single-chain-surfactant magnitude ~0.08 K-1 at I=0.01 M (SDS micelles; Piazza and Guarino PRL 2002, Vigolo et al. Langmuir 2010), and the measured Debye-length scaling. The marine-vent exclusion is ROBUST: it holds under BOTH the steep Piazza-Guarino SDS law (S_T proportional to lambda_D^2, the closest single-chain analog) and the gentlest defensible Duhr-Braun flat-double-layer law (proportional to lambda_D) - closing only at freshwater (I <= ~0.01-0.03 M) and leaving the marine vent (I ~0.5-0.7 M) short by 6-7 orders in both. The prior ad-hoc lambda_D^2 scaling coincides with the measured SDS law, so grounding STRENGTHENS rather than overturns the freshwater-favored conclusion. Charge screening at seawater salinity is the physical cause; the only soft spot is the exact closure boundary (I~0.01 vs 0.03), which still rides on the SDS-class magnitude anchor (no decanoate/oleate Soret-vs-salinity datum exists). Implication: the compartmentation step favors a low-salinity (terrestrial/freshwater-geothermal; cf. Mulkidjanian) setting over the marine alkaline vent - the investigation's central marine-vs-terrestrial debate.

ALTERNATIVE MECHANISM (follow-up): a heated gas-bubble / interface accumulator grounded in Morasch et al. (Nat Chem 2019; ~700-fold at dT 20 K rising to a ~4000-fold ceiling at dT 40 K, within minutes) was built and coupled to the same loop. It does NOT close the gap: at the canonical point conc aggregation_competent reaches only ~3.8e-4 (dT 40 K), and even at the favorable corner ~0.06 - short by >1 order, because the bubble has a HARD measured ~4000x ceiling unlike the trap's unbounded exponential (>1e8). The matched non-concentrating control confirms the enrichment is the sole mover. The gas bubble's real advantages are speed (minutes vs hours) and direct encapsulation (~18x inside vesicles), not raw magnitude; Morasch's own reading - fast interface capture SEEDING a slow exponential trap (the two are complementary and combinable) - is the promising combined mechanism to test next.

studies.claim: Reciprocal chemistry-boundary self-maintenance can close spatially: coupling the vent pore's real thermophoretic (Baaske) trap to the refuted loop lifts the amphiphile pool across its CAC and earns a membrane without a built-in gain - but only at near-maximal trapping (S_T >= ~0.07, dT >= ~45 K). At conservative vent Soret it does not close, so the refutation is re-cast as a quantified conditional, not overturned.

derived.insight: The control (no concentration) reproduces og-self-maintaining-individual exactly: base aggregation_competent 9.46e-8, matching the documented ~9e-8 canonical shortfall. The connected model inherits the refutation before adding the pore.

studies.name: og-evolvable-lineages
studies.title: Evolvable Lineages: Can a Granted Individual Evolve?
studies.question: Do mechanically defensible daughters carry heritable chemical variation that produces a multi-generation, open-ended evolutionary response - beyond a fixed trait space?
methods: fitness grounded in composition -> retention -> division-rate coupling
Wright-Fisher selection vs matched no-inheritance AND shared-feed nulls

parent_studies.provides: the (granted) self-maintaining individual that must divide (from og-self-maintaining-individual; its endogenous closure refuted)
the mechanically defensible division geometry producing viable daughters
the selectable inherited difference + population-shift-under-selection result being extended toward open-endedness

findings.evidence_basis_note: The composition shift and parent-offspring correlation are model outputs over replicate seeds (not fit); the response is measured against BOTH matched nulls.
findings.statement: Given a granted individual, heritable selection is real: the population mean composition shifts strongly (~0.38 -> ~0.91, shift ~0.5 over seeds) with parent-offspring fitness correlation ~0.9, far above both the no-inheritance null (shift ~0) and the shared-feed null (drift ~0). Not a Vasas washout - the compositional inheritance carries selectable variance.

evidence.observed: full shift ~0.5 (r ~0.9) vs no-inheritance ~0 and shared-feed ~0

findings.explanation: Fitness rises with retention (higher standing pool -> higher division rate), so selection pulls the inherited composition toward the high-retention optimum; breaking heredity OR removing the fitness differential abolishes it.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The changed-environment re-tracking is a model output; the adaptation magnitude is compared to the no-inheritance null.
findings.statement: The inheriting population adapts to a changed environment: when the favored composition is flipped mid-run, the population re-tracks toward the new optimum, well above the no-inheritance null - multi-generation adaptation to change is real given an individual.

evidence.observed: full re-tracks strongly after the optimum flip; no-inheritance null does not

findings.explanation: Heredity + the re-pointed fitness gradient let selection move the population to the new optimum within the trait space.

findings.evidence_basis_note: The bounded character is extrapolated from the heritable-variance trajectory (declines as it converges) and the fixed scalar trait space; open-endedness is not a fitted quantity but is denied by these structural facts.
findings.statement: The evolvability is bounded fixed-trait selection, not open-ended: heritable variance declines (ratio final/initial < 1) as the population converges to the single optimum, and the trait is a fixed scalar - the changed-environment adaptation is re-tracking within the same fixed trait space, not new organization. Vasas-2010-consistent for the compositional regime: real selection, but no open-ended novelty.

evidence.observed: heritable variance ratio final/initial < 1 (FAIL vs 1.0); fixed scalar trait space

findings.explanation: A fixed scalar trait with one optimum admits bounded selection that consumes its variance on convergence; genuine open-endedness needs a novelty-generating trait space this model does not include - so the honest reading is bounded, not open-ended.

findings.statement: Synthesis across the arc: given an individual, evolvability works but is bounded; and og-self-maintaining-individual showed the individual does not form endogenously. So the binding bottleneck of the chemistry-to-life transition here is individuality, not evolvability - a clean close to the arc, with both §9 open transitions resolved as quantified-conditional rather than demonstrated.

evidence.observed: evolvability present-but-bounded (og-evolvable-lineages) while endogenous individuality refuted (og-self-maintaining-individual)

findings.explanation: This study isolates evolvability from individuality by granting the individual; evolvability clears its bar (bounded) while individuality (og-self-maintaining-individual) does not, locating the hard step at individuality.

studies.claim: Given a granted individual, stochastic partition + variation produce real heritable, selectable adaptation that shifts the population strongly above both matched nulls (no-inheritance and shared-feed) and re-tracks a changed environment - but it is bounded fixed-trait selection (heritable variance declines as it converges; the trait space is a fixed scalar), not open-ended novelty. Combined with og-self-maintaining-individual: the individuality bottleneck is the binding one; given an individual, evolvability works but is bounded. Qualified.

derived.insight: Given a granted individual, heritable selection is real: the population mean composition shifts strongly (~0.38 -> ~0.91, shift ~0.5 over seeds) with parent-offspring fitness correlation ~0.9, far above both the no-inheritance null (shift ~0) and the shared-feed null (drift ~0). Not a Vasas washout - the compositional inheritance carries selectable variance.
